title: Multicentre benchmark of PSMA PET/CT and mpMRI fusion for non-invasive clinically significant prostate cancer diagnosis
zh_title: PSMA PET/CT与mpMRI融合的多中心基准
summary: 三院527例配对影像，模型单中心开发、两中心外部验证，PSMA PET/CT增量价值最大。
key_points: 527例来自三家医院，含病理活检标签
363例开发，164例两外部中心独立评估
比较多种编码器、三种融合策略与跨模态Transformer
reason: 多中心外部验证+配对多模态真实世界数据，但样本数百例，属重要档偏下
abstract: Clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) guides-biopsy and treatment decisions, yet its non-invasive diagnosis remains challenging. The incremental value of PSMA PET/CT beyond multiparametric MRI (mpMRI), and the optimal strategy for multimodal fusion, remain unclear. We established a real-world, multicentre benchmark using 527 patients from three hospitals with fully paired PSMA PET, CT, T2-weighted MRI, and diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI), together with pathology-confirmed biopsy labels. Models were developed in one centre ( n = 363) and independently evaluated in two external centres ( n = 164). We compared frozen pretrained encoders, fine-tuned 2D and 3D CNN and Vision Transformer models, three fusion strategies, and an interpretable cross-modal Transformer. PSMA PET provided the greatest incremental value, with its removal producing the largest AUC reduction internally (−0.077) and externally (−0.055), supported by the highest attention attribution (αPET = 0.45). PSMA PET/CT also outperformed mpMRI externally (AUC 0.753 vs. 0.653). DWI was the principal source of domain shift, as its exclusion improved external AUC by 0.079 amid inter-centre b-value heterogeneity. Intermediate fusion performed most consistently internally, whereas late fusion and pretrained 2D models generalised better externally. This benchmark supports robust, non-invasive csPCa diagnosis by identifying modalities and fusion strategies that generalise reliably across institutions.
zh_abstract: 临床显著性前列腺癌（clinically significant prostate cancer, csPCa）指导活检和治疗决策，但其无创诊断仍具有挑战性。PSMA PET/CT相对于多参数MRI（multiparametric MRI, mpMRI）的增量价值，以及多模态融合的最佳策略，仍不清楚。我们建立了一个真实世界、多中心基准，使用来自三家医院的527例患者，具备完全配对的PSMA PET、CT、T2加权MRI和弥散加权成像（diffusion-weighted imaging, DWI），以及经病理确认的活检标签。模型在一个中心（n = 363）开发，并在两个外部中心（n = 164）独立评估。我们比较了冻结预训练编码器、微调的2D和3D CNN及Vision Transformer模型、三种融合策略，以及一个可解释的跨模态Transformer。PSMA PET提供了最大的增量价值，其移除在内部（−0.077）和外部（−0.055）产生最大的AUC下降，并得到最高注意力归因（αPET = 0.45）的支持。PSMA PET/CT在外部也优于mpMRI（AUC 0.753 vs. 0.653）。DWI是域偏移的主要来源，因为在其排除后，在中心间b值异质性的情况下，外部AUC提高了0.079。中间融合在内部表现最一致，而后期融合和预训练2D模型在外部泛化更好。该基准通过识别能够在不同机构间可靠泛化的模态和融合策略，支持稳健、无创的csPCa诊断。

title: Systemwide adoption patterns of ambient AI scribe technology in an integrated academic health system
zh_title: 大型学术医疗系统环境AI病历助手全员推广采用模式
summary: 回顾性观察研究分析2901名门诊医生在集成学术医疗系统内使用环境AI记录助手的采用率与就诊层面使用率差异。
key_points: 2901名门诊医生，2024年12月至2025年5月EHR与厂商使用数据
社区内科67%、社区儿科69%采用率最高，学术普外16%、妇产科18%最低
采用率与使用率在执业场景、专科和医生类型间差异显著
reason: 同行评审、企业级规模化部署真实采用数据，但为单系统回顾性观察，无临床结局
abstract: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes may reduce documentation burden, but little is known about their adoption during enterprise-scale ambulatory rollout. We conducted a retrospective observational cohort study of 2901 ambulatory clinicians at an integrated academic health system using linked electronic health record and vendor usage data from December 2024 through May 2025. Clinician adoption was defined as any use during the study period, and monthly visit-level uptake as the proportion of eligible ambulatory visits in which the ambient AI scribe was used. Adoption and uptake varied substantially across practice settings, specialties, and clinician types. Clinician-level adoption was highest in community internal medicine (67%), community general pediatrics (69%), and academic neurology (53%), and lowest in academic general surgery (16%), obstetrics and gynecology (18%), and psychiatry (19%). Community attending physicians and advanced practice providers showed marked increases in median visit-level uptake, reaching approximately 80%-90% in some groups by May 2025. Distinct longitudinal patterns included slow and steady adoption, early use followed by discontinuation, transient use, and late adoption. These findings suggest that implementation support and evaluation strategies should be tailored to local practice context rather than applied uniformly across a health system.
zh_abstract: 环境人工智能（ambient artificial intelligence, AI）记录员可能减轻文书负担，但对其在企业规模门诊推广中的采用情况知之甚少。我们开展了一项回顾性观察性队列研究，纳入某整合型学术医疗系统的2901名门诊临床医生，使用关联的电子健康记录和供应商使用数据，时间范围为2024年12月至2025年5月。临床医生采用定义为研究期间任何使用；月度就诊层面使用率定义为符合条件的门诊就诊中使用环境AI记录员的比例。采用情况和使用率在不同实践环境、专科和临床医生类型之间差异很大。临床医生层面采用率最高的是社区内科（67%）、社区普通儿科（69%）和学术神经科（53%），最低的是学术普通外科（16%）、妇产科（18%）和精神科（19%）。社区主治医师和高级实践提供者在就诊层面使用率中位数上显著增加，到2025年5月某些组达到约80%-90%。不同的纵向模式包括缓慢而稳定的采用、早期使用后停用、短暂使用和晚期采用。这些发现提示，实施支持和评估策略应根据当地实践背景量身定制，而不是在整个医疗系统中统一应用。

title: Visual-affective decoding enhances neurofunctional objective and generalizable signatures in unseen adolescent depression diagnosis
zh_title: 观影fMRI视觉-情感解码诊断青少年抑郁
summary: 200名青少年中，观影态fMRI视觉-情感解码模型区分抑郁与健康对照AUC 0.87，并外推至独立队列。
key_points: 200名青少年，含112例抑郁与88例对照
仅用健康对照训练的双通路异常检测
AUC 0.87，敏感度95.56%，外推独立队列
reason: 同行评审并有独立队列外推，但样本仅200、非临床结局，值得一看档
abstract: Adolescent major depressive disorder is a highly prevalent and debilitating condition, yet objective and generalizable neurofunctional signatures remain elusive. Existing neuroimaging approaches largely rely on resting-state fMRI, or controlled tasks often lack ecological validity and generalizable signatures of depression-related neural dysfunctions. This study proposes a Visual–Affective Decoding (VAD) framework integrating cross-subject visual and affective decoding from whole-brain fMRI acquired during naturalistic movie viewing. A dual-pathway anomaly detection model trained exclusively on healthy controls establishes normative brain function and identifies MDD through deviations from this norm. In 200 adolescents (112 MDD, 88 HC), VAD achieved an AUC of 0.87, 95.56% sensitivity, 83.89% accuracy, and 72.22% specificity. Using the same anomaly threshold, it generalized to an independent external adolescent cohort (70 MDD, 68 HC), achieving an AUC of 0.81 with an accuracy of 75.36%, supporting its cross-site generalizability. VAD further revealed interpretable neurofunctional signatures, including blunted emotional reactivity, attenuated visual representation, and affective patterns consistent with emotional rumination. Region-level contribution analyses identified dissociable visual- and affective-sensitive cortical regions, consistent with dysfunctions in visual, default-mode, salience, and higher-order associative networks. These findings demonstrate that VAD provides objective, interpretable, and generalizable neurofunctional signatures for adolescent depression diagnosis and clinically relevant biomarker development.
zh_abstract: 青少年重性抑郁障碍（MDD）是一种高度流行且致残的疾病，但客观且可泛化的神经功能特征仍难以获得。现有神经影像方法主要依赖静息态功能磁共振成像（fMRI），或受控任务往往缺乏生态效度和抑郁症相关神经功能障碍的可泛化特征。本研究提出一种视觉-情感解码（Visual–Affective Decoding, VAD）框架，整合来自自然观看电影期间采集的全脑fMRI的跨受试者视觉和情感解码。一个仅在健康对照者上训练的双通路异常检测模型建立规范性脑功能，并通过偏离该规范来识别MDD。在200名青少年（112例MDD，88例HC）中，VAD达到AUC为0.87、灵敏度95.56%、准确率83.89%和特异度72.22%。使用相同的异常阈值，它泛化到一个独立的外部青少年队列（70例MDD，68例HC），达到AUC为0.81、准确率75.36%，支持其跨站点泛化性。VAD进一步揭示了可解释的神经功能特征，包括情感反应迟钝、视觉表征减弱以及与情绪反刍一致的情感模式。区域水平贡献分析识别出可分离的视觉和情感敏感皮层区域，与视觉、默认模式、显著性和高级联合网络的功能障碍一致。这些发现表明，VAD为青少年抑郁症诊断和临床相关生物标志物开发提供了客观、可解释且可泛化的神经功能特征。

title: Masked Position Modeling as a Pre-Training Strategy for Foundational Deformable Image Registration Models.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: 掩码位置建模预训练形变配准基础模型
summary: IEEE TMI 提出 MPM-Reg，用掩码位置建模实现模态无关的 Transformer 形变配准预训练范式。
key_points: 针对形变配准缺乏合适预训练方案的问题
MPM-Reg 为可迁移、模态无关的预训练策略
使纯 Transformer 模型可用于配准基础模型
reason: 同行评审的新预训练方法，但无外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] The core objective of deformable image registration (DIR), estimating a displacement vector field that aligns two images, is fundamentally the same across imaging modalities and anatomical regions. Although this shared objective should imply the use of foundation models, most deep learning approaches for DIR operate within narrow domain-specific settings. Vision Transformers (ViTs) are the predominant choice for foundation models in many image processing tasks due to their excellent generalization capabilities and robustness to domain shifts. However, their use remains largely underexplored for DIR, which we attribute to a lack of suitable pre-training schemes. To address this need, we introduce MPM-Reg, a transferable, modality-agnostic training paradigm based on masked position modeling (MPM), enabling the use of fully transformer-based models as foundation models for image registration. Unlike conventional masked data modeling, which predicts the content of masked image patches, MPM masks the positional information and predicts the spatial relationship between image patches. Initially, we employ MPM on single images, which naturally aligns self-supervised pre-training of ViTs with the downstream registration task. Subsequently, we extend MPM to predict the positions of target patches within source images, re-formulating DIR through the lens of MPM. Experiments across eleven diverse datasets demonstrate MPM-Reg's competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Crucially, MPM-Reg benefits from heterogeneous multi-domain data, which degrades the performance of existing methods, paving the way for scalable foundation models for DIR.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 可变形图像配准（deformable image registration, DIR）的核心目标是估计一个使两幅图像对齐的位移向量场，这一目标在不同成像模态和解剖区域之间本质上是相同的。尽管这一共同目标应意味着可以使用基础模型，但大多数用于DIR的深度学习方法仍在狭窄的特定领域设置中运行。视觉Transformer（Vision Transformers, ViTs）因其出色的泛化能力和对域偏移的鲁棒性，在许多图像处理任务中成为基础模型的主要选择。然而，它们在DIR中的应用仍很大程度上未被充分探索，我们将此归因于缺乏合适的预训练方案。为满足这一需求，我们提出MPM-Reg，一种基于掩码位置建模（masked position modeling, MPM）的可迁移、模态无关的训练范式，使完全基于Transformer的模型能够作为图像配准的基础模型。与传统掩码数据建模预测被掩码图像块的内容不同，MPM掩蔽位置信息并预测图像块之间的空间关系。首先，我们在单幅图像上采用MPM，这自然使ViTs的自监督预训练与下游配准任务相一致。随后，我们将MPM扩展到预测源图像中目标图像块的位置，通过MPM的视角重新表述DIR。在十一个多样化数据集上的实验表明，MPM-Reg与最先进的基线相比具有竞争力。关键的是，MPM-Reg受益于异构多域数据，而这种数据会降低现有方法的性能，为可扩展的DIR基础模型铺平道路。

title: GliaDose: An alternative approach for clinical CAR-T dose prediction via PBPK–glioblastoma-on-a-chip integration
zh_title: GliaDose：PBPK与胶质瘤芯片联用的CAR-T剂量预测
summary: 提出整合PBPK模型与血管化胶质母细胞瘤器官芯片的混合框架，用于CAR-T首次人体剂量预测。
key_points: CAR-T具非线性药代动力学，动物到人体外推不可靠
PBPK模型仅用人源生理数据参数化
与胶质瘤-on-a-chip平台结合进行定量剂量预测
reason: 同行评审新方法预印框架，但未见临床验证或外部队列，属值得一看档
abstract: Glioblastoma (GBM) is a highly aggressive brain tumor with poor prognosis and limited treatment options. Chimeric antigen receptor T cell (CAR-T) therapy has emerged as a promising immunotherapy for GBM. However, unlike conventional drugs, CAR-T cells are living therapeutics that exhibit non-linear pharmacokinetics, expansion, and complex tissue trafficking, making conventional animal-to-human dose extrapolation unreliable. Furthermore, species-specific differences and the vasculature limit the translational relevance of preclinical models. To address these challenges, we developed GliaDose, a hybrid framework that integrates physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling with a vascularized glioblastoma-on-a-chip (GoC) platform to support quantitative first-in-human dose (FIHD) prediction for CAR-T therapy. The PBPK model was parameterized exclusively with human physiological data and incorporates a brain-tumor compartment to explicitly capture CAR-T transport across the vasculature. Complementarily, the GoC platform recapitulates key features of the GBM microenvironment, including three-dimensional tumor architecture, extracellular matrix, and perfusable human vascular networks, enabling assessment of CAR-T transmigration under flow conditions. Integration of GoC-derived efficacy data into the PBPK framework enabled quantitative dose–response predictions and identified vascular barriers as critical determinants of CAR-T tumor access. GliaDose provides a human-relevant, mechanistic alternative to animal-based dose selection and may improve FIHD prediction and personalized CAR-T therapy for GBM.
zh_abstract: 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是一种高度侵袭性的脑肿瘤，预后差且治疗选择有限。嵌合抗原受体 T 细胞（CAR-T）疗法已成为 GBM 一种有前景的免疫疗法。然而，与传统药物不同，CAR-T 细胞是活体治疗产品，表现出非线性药代动力学、扩增和复杂的组织转运，使传统的动物到人体剂量外推不可靠。此外，物种特异性差异和血管系统限制了临床前模型的转化相关性。为应对这些挑战，我们开发了 GliaDose，这是一种混合框架，将基于生理学的药代动力学（PBPK）建模与血管化胶质母细胞瘤芯片（GoC）平台相结合，以支持 CAR-T 疗法的定量首次人体剂量（FIHD）预测。该 PBPK 模型仅使用人体生理数据进行参数化，并纳入脑肿瘤隔室，以明确捕捉 CAR-T 跨血管的转运。作为补充，GoC 平台重现了 GBM 微环境的关键特征，包括三维肿瘤结构、细胞外基质和可灌注的人血管网络，从而能够在流动条件下评估 CAR-T 的跨内皮迁移。将 GoC 衍生的疗效数据整合到 PBPK 框架中，实现了定量剂量–反应预测，并确定血管屏障是 CAR-T 进入肿瘤的关键决定因素。GliaDose 提供了一种与人体相关、基于机制的替代方案，可替代基于动物的剂量选择，并可能改善 GBM 的 FIHD 预测和个体化 CAR-T 治疗。

title: Artificial intelligence in acute stroke imaging: A comprehensive survey from imaging assessment to outcome prediction.
source: PubMed · Computerized medical imaging and graphics : the official journal of the Computerized Medical Imaging Society
zh_title: 急性卒中影像AI综述：从影像评估到预后预测
summary: PRISMA式检索综述84篇同行评审文献，比较缺血性卒中与脑出血影像深度学习流程的任务差异与共同框架缺失。
key_points: 覆盖84篇文献，采用PRISMA规范检索
脑出血以CT为主，聚焦出血识别与分型
指出两类卒中技术差异未被统一框架考察
reason: 系统综述纳入84篇研究、结论明确，按综述档上限给6分
abstract: [Computerized medical imaging and graphics : the official journal of the Computerized Medical Imaging Society] Acute strokes encompass two main types: acute ischemic stroke (AIS) and intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH). Each type involves specific imaging techniques and entails different clinical considerations. While deep learning has facilitated the analysis of stroke imaging autonomously, the technical differences between these two stroke types have not been examined within a shared analytical framework. This review addresses that gap through the examination of 84 peer-reviewed articles. A PRISMA-compliant search was conducted using multiple databases. Analysis of the ICH pipeline predominantly uses CT imaging and is primarily centered on a classification task. The main focus is on hemorrhage identification, subtype classification, hematoma expansion prediction, and forecasting associated clinical outcomes. The AIS pipeline is primarily based on quantification and therefore uses a variety of imaging techniques to optimize and automate the analysis of a specific set of clinical questions related to the stroke. Core tasks include segmentation of the infarct area, assessment scoring, large vessel occlusion, core-penumbra mismatch analysis, and prediction of outcomes. Convergence is also observed in outcome prediction approaches across both domains. Existing models demonstrate clinically acceptable performance across numerous tasks. Clinical deployment nonetheless remains limited by the lack of external validation, high costs of annotation, demands of real-time processing, and poor prospective evidence. This review offers practical guidance to develop fully operational AI systems that can be integrated into emergency stroke care.
zh_abstract: [《计算机化医学成像与图形》（Computerized Medical Imaging and Graphics）：计算机化医学成像学会（Computerized Medical Imaging Society）官方期刊] 急性卒中包括两种主要类型：急性缺血性卒中（AIS）和脑出血（ICH）。每种类型涉及特定影像技术，并带来不同的临床考量。尽管深度学习已促进卒中影像的自主分析，但这两类卒中的技术差异尚未在共享分析框架内得到考察。本综述通过考察 84 篇同行评议文章来填补这一空白。使用多个数据库进行了符合 PRISMA 的检索。对 ICH 流程的分析主要使用 CT 成像，且主要集中于分类任务。主要关注点包括出血识别、亚型分类、血肿扩大预测以及预测相关临床结局。AIS 流程主要基于定量分析，因此使用多种影像技术来优化和自动化分析与卒中相关的一组特定临床问题。核心任务包括梗死区分割、评估评分、大血管闭塞、核心-缺血半暗带不匹配分析以及结局预测。在两个领域的结果预测方法中也观察到趋同。现有模型在众多任务中表现出临床可接受的性能。然而，临床部署仍受限于缺乏外部验证、标注成本高、实时处理需求以及前瞻性证据不足。本综述为开发可整合到急诊卒中救治中的完全可运行 AI 系统提供实用指导。

title: Auditing evaluation artifacts and data leakage in large language model systems for rare disease diagnosis
zh_title: 罕见病诊断大模型评测泄漏审计
summary: 审计6万余例罕见病病例，指出候选空间污染会虚高多模态大模型（LLM）的诊断表现，严格跨数据集隔离后Recall@1明显下降。
key_points: 6万余例来自公开与独立临床队列
候选集污染人为抬高诊断表现
跨数据集隔离后Recall@1由54.3%下降
reason: 6万例级多队列实证审计，量化数据泄漏影响，属重要档
abstract: Augmented large language model (LLM) systems have reported high benchmark accuracies in rare disease diagnosis, yet their real-world clinical utility remains unproven. A recent meta-analysis flagged augmented LLM diagnostic evaluations as having a high risk of bias due to suspected data leakage; however, the precise impact of these vulnerabilities on model inference has yet to be fully quantified. In this study, we present a comprehensive empirical audit to quantify evaluation artifacts across prevailing AI paradigms, using a repository of over 60,000 cases from diverse public and independent clinical cohorts. By reconstructing a state-of-the-art agentic framework, we demonstrate that candidate-space contamination artificially inflates performance: enforcing strict cross-dataset isolation resulted in a marked performance decline, with the cross-dataset mean Recall@1 decreasing from 54.3% (under conventional one-vs-rest evaluation) to 40.3% (Hedges' g = 0.94). Similar spatial overfitting in supervised classifiers caused diagnostic accuracy to drop from an internal mean of 42.9% to 16.7% across external cohorts (Cohen's d = 2.01). Furthermore, we quantify how LLMs infer diagnoses by exploiting retrospective therapeutic cues in clinical narratives, and how temporal misalignment in foundational knowledge bases leads to performance fluctuations. We conclude that prevailing evaluation protocols for augmented LLM systems inadvertently reflect data leakage rather than genuine medical reasoning. To address these systematic artifacts, we propose a rigorous evaluation framework - coupling strict data-isolation protocols with standardized benchmarking safeguards - to ensure future diagnostic AI for rare diseases is evaluated on actual clinical robustness.
zh_abstract: 增强型大语言模型（large language model, LLM）系统在罕见病诊断中报告了高基准准确率，但其真实世界临床效用仍未得到证实。最近一项荟萃分析将增强型LLM诊断评估标记为因疑似数据泄漏而具有高偏倚风险；然而，这些漏洞对模型推理的确切影响尚未完全量化。在本研究中，我们开展全面的实证审计，以量化主流AI范式中的评估伪影，使用来自多样公共和独立临床队列的超过60,000例病例库。通过重建最先进的智能体框架，我们证明候选空间污染人为夸大了性能：强制执行严格的跨数据集隔离导致性能显著下降，跨数据集平均Recall@1从54.3%（在传统一对其余（one-vs-rest）评估下）降至40.3%（Hedges' g = 0.94）。监督分类器中类似的空间过拟合导致诊断准确率从内部平均42.9%降至外部队列的16.7%（Cohen's d = 2.01）。此外，我们量化了LLM如何通过利用临床叙述中的回顾性治疗线索推断诊断，以及基础知识库中的时间错配如何导致性能波动。我们得出结论，增强型LLM系统的主流评估方案无意中反映的是数据泄漏，而非真正的医学推理。为处理这些系统性伪影，我们提出严谨的评估框架——将严格数据隔离方案与标准化基准测试保障措施相结合——以确保未来罕见病诊断AI基于真实临床稳健性接受评估。

title: Multimodal Generative AI Assists Comprehensive Echocardiographic Interpretation
zh_title: EchoChat：多模态生成式AI辅助超声心动图综合判读
summary: 基于46358例检查训练的超声心动图视觉语言模型，在六个国际队列取得新的最优表现。
key_points: 构建EchoChat多模态生成式视觉语言模型
训练集含46358例超声心动图指令对
六个国际队列验证并给出思维链依据
reason: 多国际队列外部验证且样本超4.6万，预印本取7分上限档。
abstract: Echocardiography is the cornerstone of cardiovascular diagnostics, yet its global utility is constrained by a critical shortage of experienced interpreters. Current artificial intelligence (AI) solutions remain limited, typically operating as opaque "black boxes" or focusing on narrow tasks that fail to capture the holistic, guideline-driven reasoning of a clinician. Here we introduce EchoChat, a generative multimodal vision-language model that performs comprehensive echocardiographic analysis to support clinician interpretation. By emulating the cognitive workflow of a cardiologist, EchoChat integrates vast medical knowledge with a chain-of-thought reasoning mechanism to explicitly ground its conclusions in visual evidence. Trained on echocardiography-instruction pairs from 46,358 examinations, our model establishes a new state-of-the-art across diverse cohorts from six international medical centers. It supports the broadest diagnostic scope of 33 cardiac conditions and findings, including 15 newly added conditions for which it achieves an average F1 of 73.7% across available external evaluations. It surpasses existing best-performing foundation models in cardiac condition recognition (improving average recall by 13.54% on shared tasks) and quantification (average R2 score increase of 0.275 on shared tasks). Furthermore, in a source-blinded echocardiographer reader study, echocardiography reports co-generated with EchoChat were rated higher in diagnostic accuracy and completeness by two senior echocardiographers, and improved diagnostic performance from 72.78% to 82.75% in terms of F1 score over routine-reader only reports. These results demonstrate that integrating clinical reasoning into multimodal AI can democratize specialist expertise and transform the standard of cardiovascular care.
zh_abstract: 超声心动图是心血管诊断的基石，但其全球应用受限于经验丰富的判读者严重短缺。当前的人工智能（AI）解决方案仍然有限，通常作为不透明的“黑箱”运行，或聚焦于狭窄任务，未能捕捉临床医生整体性、指南驱动的推理过程。在此，我们介绍 EchoChat，一种生成式多模态视觉-语言模型，可执行全面的超声心动图分析以支持临床医生判读。通过模拟心脏病学家的认知工作流程，EchoChat 将广泛的医学知识与思维链推理机制相结合，使其结论明确建立在视觉证据之上。该模型在来自 46,358 次检查的超声心动图-指令对上进行训练，在来自六个国际医学中心的多样队列中建立了新的最先进水平。它支持最广泛的诊断范围，涵盖 33 种心脏状况和发现，其中包括 15 种新增状况；在可获得的外部评估中，其对这些新增状况的平均 F1 达到 73.7%。它在心脏状况识别（在共享任务上平均召回率提高 13.54%）和量化（在共享任务上平均 R2 评分提高 0.275）方面超越了现有表现最佳的基础模型。此外，在一项来源盲法的超声心动图医师阅片研究中，由两名资深超声心动图医师评定，与 EchoChat 共同生成的超声心动图报告在诊断准确性和完整性方面评分更高，并且相较于仅由常规读片者生成的报告，其诊断性能按 F1 评分从 72.78% 提高到 82.75%。这些结果表明，将临床推理整合到多模态 AI 中可使专科知识普及化，并转变心血管照护的标准。

title: U-NeXt: General-purpose event detection for neonatal EEG
zh_title: U-NeXt：新生儿脑电事件检测通用框架
summary: 提出基于语义分割的U-NeXt框架，统一检测新生儿脑电低电压段、伪差与癫痫发作，并在两个独立外部数据集验证。
key_points: 训练集含51/98/278名新生儿，逾1.1万小时脑电
82,000条标注事件，与任务专用ConvNeXt分类器对比
在Helsinki与Cork两个独立留出集（130名新生儿）外部验证
reason: 大样本多任务训练并有两个独立外部数据集验证，达重要档；预印本不高于8
abstract: We developed U-NeXt, a general framework for neonatal electroencephalography (EEG) event detection based on semantic segmentation. Its convolutional encoder-decoder directly segments individual channels using long input segments to preserve temporal context. A shared architecture and training framework were developed using low-voltage interval, artefact, and seizure datasets containing 51, 98, and 278 neonates, respectively, comprising over 11,000 hours of EEG and 82,000 annotated events. Performance was compared with task-specific ConvNeXt classifiers. For seizure detection, we also evaluated U-NeXt+, trained on an expanded dataset. Both U-NeXt variants and the ConvNeXt baseline were evaluated on two independent held-out seizure datasets, Helsinki and Cork, comprising 130 neonates, with recordings annotated by three experts. U-NeXt improved detection across all three event types, with particular gains in sensitivity for short events. U-NeXt+ achieved Matthews correlation coefficients of 0.862 and 0.891 on Helsinki and Cork, respectively, and improved hourly seizure burden correlations by 30-40% relative to ConvNeXt. U-NeXt+ met the criterion for expert-level performance on both datasets (p < 0.001). In separate computational benchmarks, U-NeXt reduced batch inference time relative to ConvNeXt by 254-fold on a central processing unit and 200-fold on a graphics processing unit. A common segmentation framework improves detection across diverse neonatal EEG event types while substantially reducing inference time. Accurate seizure burden estimates and performance comparable to expert reviewers support its potential use in continuous monitoring and clinical decision support.
zh_abstract: 我们开发了U-NeXt，一种基于语义分割的新生儿脑电图（EEG）事件检测通用框架。其卷积编码器-解码器使用长输入片段直接分割单个通道，以保留时间背景。使用分别包含51、98和278名新生儿的低电压间期、伪差和癫痫发作数据集，开发了共享架构和训练框架，包括超过11,000小时的EEG和82,000个标注事件。性能与任务特定的ConvNeXt分类器进行比较。对于癫痫发作检测，我们还评估了在扩展数据集上训练的U-NeXt+。两种U-NeXt变体和ConvNeXt基线均在两个独立的留出癫痫发作数据集Helsinki和Cork上评估，包含130名新生儿，记录由三位专家标注。U-NeXt改善了所有三种事件类型的检测，在短事件灵敏度方面尤其有提升。U-NeXt+在Helsinki和Cork上分别达到0.862和0.891的Matthews相关系数，并且相对于ConvNeXt，每小时癫痫负荷相关性提高30-40%。U-NeXt+在两个数据集上均达到专家级性能标准（p < 0.001）。在单独的计算基准测试中，U-NeXt相对于ConvNeXt将批量推理时间在中央处理单元上减少254倍，在图形处理单元上减少200倍。一个通用的分割框架改善了多种新生儿EEG事件类型的检测，同时大幅减少推理时间。准确的癫痫负荷估计和与专家审阅者相当的性能支持其在连续监测和临床决策支持中的潜在用途。

title: Longitudinal AI-Assisted Management of Indeterminate Pulmonary Nodules

title: scMAC: large language model-enhanced single-cell functional priors for completing functional context in bulk T cell receptor repertoires.
zh_title: scMAC：大模型增强单细胞先验补全TCR功能
summary: 同行评审研究提出scMAC框架，用单细胞功能先验为bulk TCR repertoire补全T细胞功能状态。
key_points: 用配对单细胞RNA/TCR构建功能先验
去噪并处理TCR与转录组间概率关系
将先验迁移至bulk TCR repertoire推断功能组成
reason: 同行评审新方法，思路清晰但条目未显示外部验证或大规模评测
abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Bulk T cell receptor (TCR) sequencing enables scalable immune repertoire profiling but does not measure the transcriptional states required to infer T cell functional programs. Paired single-cell RNA/TCR sequencing offers a single-cell functional prior by jointly observing TCR identity and transcriptomic states. However, transferring this prior to bulk repertoires is challenging: sparse and noisy single-cell profiles can distort the functional reference, and the probabilistic relationship between TCR identity and transcriptome-inferred functional state makes direct cell-level alignment unstable, potentially biasing repertoire-level functional composition estimation. We present scMAC, a single-cell-guided framework for functional context completion that infers TCR functional representations reflecting transcriptome-derived T-cell states. scMAC builds a denoised functional reference by integrating multi-scale expression modeling with gene-semantic priors derived from large language model encodings of gene and protein descriptions, improving gene-level functional coherence. It then learns a prototype-guided TCR-to-function mapping that combines paired cell-level latent alignment with functional prototype regularization, enabling robust repertoire-level functional composition estimation. Across real single-cell and paired RNA/TCR datasets, scMAC outperformed existing single-cell representation methods in fine-grained cell-state representation, gene functional consistency, expression recovery, and disease-relevant pathway analysis, achieving an adjusted Rand index of 0.656 on a colorectal cancer dataset with 83 cell subtypes. For repertoire-level functional composition estimation, scMAC closely matched single-cell-derived functional proportions, with an R2 of 0.979 and a Bray-Curtis distance of 0.075. These results support scMAC as a practical route for transferring single-cell-derived functional knowledge to bulk TCR repertoire analysis beyond clonotype identity and clonal abundance. scMAC is publicly available at https://github.com/Bioinformatics7181/scMAC.
zh_abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] 批量 T 细胞受体（TCR）测序可实现可扩展的免疫组库分析，但无法测量推断 T 细胞功能程序所需的转录状态。配对的单细胞 RNA/TCR 测序通过联合观察 TCR 身份和转录组状态，提供单细胞功能先验。然而，将该先验迁移到批量组库具有挑战性：稀疏且嘈杂的单细胞图谱可能扭曲功能参考，而 TCR 身份与转录组推断的功能状态之间的概率关系使直接的细胞水平对齐不稳定，可能使组库水平的功能组成估计产生偏差。我们提出 scMAC，一种单细胞引导的功能背景补全框架，可推断反映转录组衍生 T 细胞状态的 TCR 功能表征。scMAC 通过整合多尺度表达建模与源自基因和蛋白质描述的大语言模型编码的基因语义先验，构建去噪的功能参考，从而提高基因水平的功能一致性。然后，它学习一种原型引导的 TCR 到功能映射，将配对的细胞水平潜在对齐与功能原型正则化相结合，从而实现稳健的组库水平功能组成估计。在真实单细胞和配对 RNA/TCR 数据集中，scMAC 在细粒度细胞状态表征、基因功能一致性、表达恢复和疾病相关通路分析方面优于现有单细胞表征方法，在一个具有 83 种细胞亚型的结直肠癌数据集上达到调整兰德指数 0.656。对于组库水平功能组成估计，scMAC 与单细胞衍生的功能比例高度匹配，R2 为 0.979，Bray-Curtis 距离为 0.075。这些结果支持 scMAC 作为将单细胞衍生的功能知识迁移到批量 TCR 组库分析（超越克隆型身份和克隆丰度）的实用途径。scMAC 公开可用，网址为 https://github.com/Bioinformatics7181/scMAC。

title: Impact of artificial intelligence in embryo selection to improve pregnancy rates per transfer in IVF cycles: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

zh_title: AI胚胎选择提升IVF每移植妊娠率的系统综述与荟萃分析
summary: 通过系统综述与荟萃分析，评估AI胚胎选择相比传统形态学方法，能否改善IVF每移植周期的妊娠结局。

abstract: [European journal of obstetrics, gynecology, and reproductive biology] Embryo selection is one of the most critical determinants of success in in vitro fertilization (IVF). Conventional approaches based on static morphological grading and time-lapse imaging (TLI) remain subjective and show only modest predictive accuracy. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools, including deep learning-based platforms such as iDAScore and KIDScore, have emerged as potentially more standardized alternatives, yet their true clinical impact on per-transfer outcomes remains uncertain. To determine whether AI-assisted embryo selection offers measurable clinical advantages over conventional morphology-based methods in IVF. A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted by searching four electronic databases (PubMed, Scopus, Embase, and the Cochrane Library) from January 2013 to April 2024. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational cohort studies evaluating AI-assisted embryo selection versus conventional morphology in IVF cycles without preimplantation genetic testing for aneuploidy (PGT-A), reporting at least one of clinical pregnancy rate (CPR), implantation rate (IR), or live birth rate (LBR). Two reviewers independently screened records and extracted data. Study quality was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool for the RCT and the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale for observational studies. Where arm-level data were available, risk ratios (RR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were pooled using a random-effects model. Ten studies were included. Only two reported arm-level outcomes suitable for meta-analysis. The pooled estimate showed no significant difference in clinical pregnancy rate between AI-assisted and morphology-based selection (RR = 0.99, 95% CI 0.87-1.12; I2 = 26.5%), with no statistically significant difference between the two methods. The remaining eight studies reported predictive performance metrics with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve values of 0.85-0.96, though these did not consistently translate into improved per-cycle outcomes. Implantation and live birth rates were inconsistently reported and could not be pooled. abstract: [Genomics, proteomics & bioinformatics] Messenger RNA (mRNA) vaccines offer promising therapeutic potential for combating various diseases, yet their inherent chemical instability hampers long-term efficacy. Although several methods have been developed to predict mRNA degradation, they often suffer from limited accuracy and lack the capability for rational codon optimization. Here, we propose RNASTOP, a novel framework that integrates deep learning with heuristic search to simultaneously predict and optimize mRNA chemical stability. RNASTOP achieves a 13% improvement in accuracy over the top-performing model on the Stanford OpenVaccine competition dataset and demonstrates robust generalization in predicting full-length mRNA degradation. When applied to mRNA codon optimization, RNASTOP reduces the minimum free energy of the varicella-zoster virus vaccine sequence by 75.73% while maintaining high translation efficiency. Overall, RNASTOP serves as a powerful tool for predicting and optimizing mRNA chemical stability, accelerating the development of mRNA therapeutics. The source code of RNASTOP is available at https://github.com/xlab-BioAI/RNASTOP.

abstract: [ACS synthetic biology] The rapid growth of genomic and metagenomic data has created a large gap between protein sequence discovery and enzyme functional characterization. Deep learning has become an important tool for enzyme-related prediction tasks, including EC and GO annotation, substrate specificity, catalytic-residue identification, kinetic-parameter estimation, thermostability, pH optima, and candidate discovery. This review summarizes recent progress with an emphasis on benchmark design rather than reported scores alone. We compare representative methods by input modality, training data, split strategy, leakage control, evaluation metric, and validation evidence. Across tasks, apparent performance gains can arise from dataset scale, annotation quality, homolog overlap, negative sampling, or endpoint definition rather than architecture alone. Current models are valuable for annotation and candidate prioritization, but robust discovery of remote homologs, rare functions, or new catalytic activities still requires low-identity or out-of-distribution evaluation and experimental validation.
zh_abstract: [ACS synthetic biology] 基因组和宏基因组数据的快速增长，已在蛋白质序列发现与酶功能表征之间造成了巨大差距。深度学习已成为酶相关预测任务的重要工具，包括 EC 和 GO 注释、底物特异性、催化残基识别、动力学参数估计、热稳定性、最适 pH 以及候选发现。本综述总结了近期进展，重点强调基准设计，而不仅仅是已报告的分数。我们按输入模态、训练数据、划分策略、泄漏控制、评价指标和验证证据比较代表性方法。跨任务来看，表观性能提升可能源于数据集规模、注释质量、同源重叠、负采样或终点定义，而不仅仅是架构。当前模型对于注释和候选优先级排序有价值，但对远源同源物、稀有功能或新催化活性的稳健发现，仍需要低一致性或分布外评估以及实验验证。

abstract: Disease diagnosis is a key application of large language model (LLM) agents in healthcare. However, existing medical agents are primarily trained and evaluated with static question-answering data, providing limited opportunities to learn active information acquisition, examination decision-making, and dynamic clinical interaction. To address this limitation, we present ClinVerse, an interactive, real-data-grounded multi-agent environment designed for training and evaluating medical diagnostic agents. Built on ClinPatient, a scalable dataset comprising 150k diagnostic cases derived from real-world electronic health records, ClinVerse supports coordinated interactions among six specialized clinical roles. Specifically, a doctor agent starts from an initial patient complaint, progressively gathers clinical evidence through patient interviews and examination requests, and ultimately produces a diagnosis. For each interaction trajectory, a rule-based scoring framework quantifies information acquisition, examination ordering, and diagnostic accuracy. These trajectory-level scores serve as reward signals for agent training while also enabling scalable evaluation. In experiments, we evaluate various general-purpose and medical-domain models and show that nine self-evolution methods across three categories consistently improve agents' diagnostic capabilities within ClinVerse. We further analyze the interplay among model capability, environment feedback, and self-evolution methods.
zh_abstract: 疾病诊断是大语言模型（LLM）智能体在医疗保健中的关键应用。然而，现有的医疗智能体主要使用静态问答数据进行训练和评估，因而学习主动信息获取、检查决策和动态临床交互的机会有限。为解决这一局限，我们提出 ClinVerse，一个交互式、基于真实数据的多智能体环境，旨在训练和评估医学诊断智能体。ClinVerse 构建于 ClinPatient 之上，后者是一个可扩展数据集，包含源自真实世界电子健康记录的 15 万例诊断病例，ClinVerse 支持六个专业临床角色之间的协同交互。具体而言，医生智能体从患者初始主诉开始，通过患者访谈和检查请求逐步收集临床证据，并最终给出诊断。对于每条交互轨迹，基于规则的评分框架量化信息获取、检查开具和诊断准确性。这些轨迹级分数作为智能体训练的奖励信号，同时也支持可扩展评估。在实验中，我们评估了多种通用和医学领域模型，并表明三大类中的九种自我进化方法在 ClinVerse 中一致提升智能体的诊断能力。我们进一步分析了模型能力、环境反馈与自我进化方法之间的相互作用。

abstract: Blood and bone marrow smears are central to diagnosing hematological disorders. While whole-slide scanning enables automated single-cell profiling at scale, the computational burden of gigapixel images has confined automated analysis to manually pre-selected regions of interest. Here, we present HemAutomaton, a framework built on neural cellular automata that extracts white blood cells across entire whole-slide images without manual region selection and with minimal annotation requirements. HemAutomaton matches the in-domain detection accuracy of Faster R-CNN while surpassing it under domain shifts, operating at a fraction of the computational cost and with over 10,000-fold fewer parameters. Across three blood cancer cohorts, we extract over 100 million single-cell images and achieve annotation-efficient differential counting via few-shot classification using a pretrained hematology foundation model. Slide-wide spatial analysis uncovers consistent blast-frequency gradients across smears and demonstrates that automated blast counts match expert evaluations within inter-expert variability. Scaling automated profiling from hundreds to tens of thousands of cells per smear overcomes conventional sampling limits and establishes the foundation for more sensitive AI supported hematological assessments.
zh_abstract: 血液和骨髓涂片是诊断血液系统疾病的核心。尽管全切片扫描能够实现规模化的自动化单细胞分析，但吉像素图像的计算负担使自动化分析局限于人工预先选择的感兴趣区域。在此，我们提出 HemAutomaton，一个基于神经细胞自动机（neural cellular automata）的框架，可在无人工区域选择且标注需求极低的情况下，从整张全切片图像中提取白细胞。HemAutomaton 在域内检测准确率上匹配 Faster R-CNN，并在域偏移（domain shifts）下超过它，同时仅需其一小部分计算成本，参数数量少超过 10,000 倍。在三个血液癌症队列中，我们提取了超过 1 亿张单细胞图像，并使用预训练的血液学基础模型通过少样本分类（few-shot classification）实现标注高效的鉴别计数。全切片空间分析揭示了各涂片中一致的原始细胞频率梯度，并证明自动原始细胞计数在专家间变异范围内与专家评估相匹配。将自动分析从每张涂片数百个细胞扩展到数万个细胞，克服了传统采样限制，并为更灵敏的 AI 支持血液学评估奠定基础。

abstract: GLP-1 medications are increasingly used for weight management, and many people share their experiences online. These narratives show why people take the drugs and what they experience, but they remain unstructured and disconnected from formal pharmacovigilance. We therefore present AskGLP1, a system that transforms online patient narratives into a knowledge graph (KG) and answers questions about medication experiences. Through an LLM-assisted pipeline grounded in the MedDRA terminology, AskGLP1 screens nearly 8.5 million Reddit posts for medication experiences and distills 163,135 of them, with 2,506 WebMD reviews, into a KG of 385,790 drug-side-effect and drug-purpose relations. We find that GLP-1 experiences are source- and drug-specific. Online narratives share the most common gastrointestinal symptoms with FAERS, but they foreground everyday burdens such as fatigue and food aversion, whereas FAERS reports more often include injection-site reactions and selected serious diagnoses such as pancreatitis. We further find that posts report less nausea and vomiting for tirzepatide than for semaglutide, more fatigue for Wegovy than Ozempic and for Zepbound than Mounjaro. Evaluations show that the agent answers with verifiable evidence and declines requests for medical advice. Our findings reveal gaps between what FAERS captures and what people report online, and they call for patient-centered approaches to pharmacovigilance. Code, prompts, and evaluation questions are available at https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/AskGLP1.
zh_abstract: GLP-1 药物越来越多地用于体重管理，许多人在网上分享其经历。这些叙述展示了人们为何服用这些药物以及他们经历了什么，但这些内容仍然是非结构化的，且与正式药物警戒脱节。因此，我们提出 AskGLP1，一个将在线患者叙述转化为知识图谱（knowledge graph, KG）并回答关于用药体验问题的系统。通过一个以 MedDRA 术语为基础的 LLM 辅助流程，AskGLP1 筛查了近 850 万条 Reddit 帖子以寻找用药体验，并将其中的 163,135 条帖子连同 2,506 条 WebMD 评论提炼为一个包含 385,790 条药物-副作用和药物-用途关系的 KG。我们发现 GLP-1 体验具有来源特异性和药物特异性。在线叙述与 FAERS 共享最常见的胃肠道症状，但它们突出疲劳和食物厌恶等日常负担，而 FAERS 报告更常包括注射部位反应以及胰腺炎等特定严重诊断。我们进一步发现，帖子报告 tirzepatide 的恶心和呕吐少于 semaglutide，Wegovy 的疲劳多于 Ozempic，Zepbound 的疲劳多于 Mounjaro。评估显示，该智能体以可验证证据作答，并拒绝提供医疗建议的请求。我们的发现揭示了 FAERS 所捕获内容与人们在网上报告内容之间的差距，并呼吁采用以患者为中心的药物警戒方法。代码、提示词和评估问题可在 https://github.com/ZhaoqianXue/AskGLP1 获取。

abstract: Background/Objectives: Rapid differentiation of ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke subtypes is vital for acute management. Although current deep learning models achieve high single-dataset accuracy, they suffer from "shortcut learning" and domain shift in external validation. This study proposes a hierarchical computer-aided diagnostic (CAD) system mimicking emergency triage. Methods: We introduce a 3-channel Radiology-Focused Preprocessing pipeline that feeds radiological Hounsfield Unit (HU) windows into Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Vision Transformer (ViT) backbones via asymmetric formats (.mat and .png). The architecture utilizes a novel joint cross-attention fusion network optimized by an Integrated Orthogonal-Focal Loss. Results: Our system achieved a 95.48% F1-score on the internal stroke dataset. However, multi-center external validation (AISD, BHSD, PhysioNet) using a Mask Anchor filter revealed a drop to the 58-62% range, exposing the "internal validation illusion" caused by hardware noise. Critically, models exhibited high precision (77%) but low sensitivity (57%) for ischemic stroke, proving prone to hemorrhage overdiagnosis. Multi-seed variance analysis demonstrated that the DenseNet201+ViT backbone yielded the lowest deviation (0.59) and highest stability, making it the most reliable architecture for real-world clinical integration. Conclusions: To overcome diagnostic challenges, future research must focus on multimodal architectures that combine 3D volumetric extraction with clinical data.
zh_abstract: 【背景/目的】快速区分缺血性与出血性卒中亚型对急性期管理至关重要。尽管当前深度学习模型在单一数据集上实现了高准确率，但在外部验证中仍受“捷径学习”（shortcut learning）和域偏移（domain shift）困扰。本研究提出一种模拟急诊分诊的分层计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统。【方法】我们引入一个3通道放射学聚焦预处理流程，通过非对称格式（.mat 和 .png）将放射学Hounsfield Unit（HU）窗输入卷积神经网络（CNN）和视觉Transformer（ViT）骨干网络。该架构采用一种新颖的联合交叉注意力融合网络，并由集成正交-焦点损失（Integrated Orthogonal-Focal Loss）优化。【结果】我们的系统在内部卒中数据集上取得了95.48%的F1分数。然而，使用掩膜锚点过滤器（Mask Anchor filter）进行多中心外部验证（AISD、BHSD、PhysioNet）时，性能下降至58-62%区间，暴露出由硬件噪声导致的“内部验证错觉”。关键的是，模型对缺血性卒中表现出高精确率（77%）但低灵敏度（57%），证明其倾向于出血过度诊断。多种子方差分析表明，DenseNet201+ViT骨干网络取得最低偏差（0.59）和最高稳定性，使其成为真实世界临床整合中最可靠的架构。【结论】为克服诊断挑战，未来研究必须聚焦于将3D体积提取与临床数据相结合的多模态架构。

title: Regional prediction of hematoma expansion from non-contrast computed tomography in spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage patients
zh_title: 脑出血平扫CT区域特征预测血肿扩大
summary: 用ERICH队列建模、VISTA队列验证，基于区域化平扫CT的传输形态学特征预测血肿扩大。
key_points: ERICH建模、VISTA外部验证
按脑叶、基底节、丘脑分区建模
结合血肿扩大与临床结局定义
reason: 含独立队列外部验证与结局定义，但为预印本回顾性建模
abstract: Background The combination of hematoma location, expansion and final volume influence neurological outcome. The aim of this study was to derive and validate a quantitative and interpretable region-based NCCT image feature model for predicting hematoma expansion. Methods The Ethnic/Racial Variations of Intracerebral Hemorrhage(ERICH) study was used for derivation and the Virtual International Trials in Stroke Archive(VISTA) was used for validation. NCCT images at presentation and 24+/-6hours were pre-processed, segmented and categorized into lobar, basal ganglia or thalamic regions. Hematoma expansion was defined by region and according to its effect on clinical outcome. Transport-based morphometry (TBM) produced a unique transport-based representation from each NCCT hematoma image. Linear classifiers applied to transport representations were used to derive a predictive model. The regional TBM model's performance was compared to alternate methods using AUROC analyses. Results The derivation dataset included 574 patients, comprising 162 lobar, 257 basal ganglia and 155 thalamic hematomas. The validation dataset included 196 patients, comprising 31 lobar, 119 basal ganglia and 46 thalamic hematomas. A combined regional model predicted hematoma expansion in the validation dataset with an AUROC of 0.787. The principal image features which varied by location were size, heterogeneity, eccentricity and density distribution towards the hematoma periphery. The regional TBM model outperformed alternative clinician based and machine-learning methods. Conclusions TBM discriminated and visualized regional features of hematoma expansion from presentation NCCT scans. This provides preliminary evidence for regional radiographic features of hematoma expansion. It has the potential to improve hematoma expansion prediction and understanding of hematoma expansion pathophysiology.
zh_abstract: 【背景】血肿位置、扩大和最终体积的组合影响神经功能结局。本研究旨在推导并验证一个定量且可解释的、基于区域的 NCCT 图像特征模型，用于预测血肿扩大。【方法】使用脑出血种族/民族差异（Ethnic/Racial Variations of Intracerebral Hemorrhage，ERICH）研究进行推导，并使用虚拟国际卒中试验档案（Virtual International Trials in Stroke Archive，VISTA）进行验证。对就诊时和 24+/-6 小时的 NCCT 图像进行预处理、分割，并分类为脑叶、基底节或丘脑区域。血肿扩大按区域定义，并根据其对临床结局的影响定义。基于传输的形态测量（Transport-based morphometry，TBM）从每幅 NCCT 血肿图像生成独特的基于传输的表示。将线性分类器应用于传输表示以推导预测模型。使用 AUROC 分析将区域 TBM 模型的性能与替代方法进行比较。【结果】推导数据集包括 574 例患者，包括 162 例脑叶、257 例基底节和 155 例丘脑血肿。验证数据集包括 196 例患者，包括 31 例脑叶、119 例基底节和 46 例丘脑血肿。一个组合区域模型在验证数据集中预测血肿扩大，AUROC 为 0.787。随位置变化的主要图像特征为大小、异质性、偏心率和朝向血肿周边的密度分布。区域 TBM 模型优于其他基于临床医生和机器学习的方法。【结论】TBM 从就诊时 NCCT 扫描中区分并可视化了血肿扩大的区域特征。这为血肿扩大的区域影像学特征提供了初步证据。它有潜力改善血肿扩大预测并加深对血肿扩大病理生理学的理解。

title: The Patient Is Always Right? Evaluating Sycophancy in Medical Diagnosis with Graded Patient Beliefs
zh_title: 分级患者信念下医学诊断中的谄媚性评估
summary: 评估九个AI模型在患者提出错误诊断信念时的顺从行为，平均23.2%采纳患者错误信念。
key_points: 九个模型平均23.2%采纳患者错误信念
面对虚构疾病仍可能顺从
罕见病声称者人设下顺从率达43.0%
医学微调与模型规模可降低易感性
reason: 预印本，多模型系统评测且揭示安全性风险，但无临床验证，属值得一看档
abstract: More people are seeking out general-purpose AI models for medical advice, including diagnosis. Yet, AI models are susceptible to sycophancy, like validating users' beliefs even when they are untrue, which could lead to false positive diagnoses. Here, we evaluate how nine AI models change their diagnostic decision when a patient presents a belief that they have a specific (but incorrect) medical condition. We vary how close the user belief is to the clinical evidence presented. Models sycophantically adopt the patient's belief on average 23.2\% of the time---sometimes even when the patient proposes a fictional, made-up condition. We also varied different personas, including a Rare Disease Claimer that got models to accept their belief 43.0\% of the time. Additional analyses find that medical fine-tuning and model scale makes models less susceptible to changing their diagnoses. Sycophantic bias in medical diagnosis raises implications for safety, especially as more people are using AI for health support.
zh_abstract: 越来越多的人正在寻求通用AI模型提供医疗建议，包括诊断。然而，AI模型容易受到谄媚倾向的影响，例如即使不真实也认可用户的信念，这可能导致假阳性诊断。在此，我们评估当患者表达其患有某种特定（但不正确）疾病的信念时，九个AI模型如何改变其诊断决策。我们改变用户信念与所呈现临床证据的接近程度。模型平均在23.2%的情况下会迎合性地采纳患者的信念——有时甚至是在患者提出虚构、编造的疾病时。我们还改变了不同人物角色，包括“罕见病声称者”，其使模型在43.0%的情况下接受其信念。额外分析发现，医学微调和模型规模使模型更不易改变其诊断。医学诊断中的谄媚偏倚对安全性提出了影响，尤其是随着越来越多的人使用AI获取健康支持。

title: MIS-VQA: An Annotation-Driven Surgical Vision-Language Dataset for Complex Surgical Understanding
zh_title: MIS-VQA：面向复杂手术理解的标注驱动视觉语言数据集
summary: 用标注驱动流程把EndoVis18与CholecT50的手术标注转为结构化文本，生成临床连贯的手术视觉问答数据。
key_points: 将阶段、器械、交互、三元组与分割标注统一为文本场景表示
由大语言模型生成多类型问答，含简洁与详细回答
指出既有医学VQA多依赖合成模板、标注稀疏
reason: 基于公开手术数据集构建的新视觉语言数据集，但为预印本且尚缺下游评测细节
abstract: Modern surgical AI increasingly requires multimodal understanding rather than isolated perception, yet existing datasets remain largely limited to single-task supervision such as recognition or templated question answering. Current medical VQA resources often rely on synthetic templates, lack natural descriptive supervision, or provide sparse annotations that hinder reasoning about spatial relations and procedural context. We introduce MIS-VQA, a surgical vision-language dataset generated through an annotation-driven pipeline that converts heterogeneous surgical annotations into structured textual scene representations. Using EndoVis18 and CholecT50, we transform phase, instrument, interaction, triplet, and segmentation labels into unified contexts that guide large language models to generate clinically coherent question-answer pairs. MIS-VQA supports four response types-concise and detailed descriptions, perception-level grounding, and multi-step reasoning-enabling hierarchical evaluation from atomic visual grounding to compositional reasoning. To address annotation sparsity, we incorporate confidence-filtered segmentation and cross-annotation consistency checks, enabling spatially grounded supervision at scale. MIS-VQA establishes a unified benchmark for surgical vision-language understanding with spatial supervision and multi-tier reasoning evaluation. To demonstrate its utility, we introduce LLaVA-SurgXpert, a family of surgical vision-language models with visual encoders to analyze how visual representations influence multimodal reasoning. Experiments show consistent improvements over existing surgical VQA baselines while revealing capability gaps between perceptual grounding and higher-level reasoning hidden in prior benchmarks.
zh_abstract: 现代外科人工智能日益需要多模态理解，而非孤立感知，然而现有数据集在很大程度上仍局限于单任务监督，例如识别或模板化问答。当前的医学视觉问答（VQA）资源往往依赖合成模板、缺乏自然描述性监督，或提供稀疏标注，从而阻碍对空间关系和手术流程上下文的推理。我们提出 MIS-VQA，这是一个通过标注驱动流程生成的外科视觉-语言数据集，该流程将异构手术标注转换为结构化文本场景表示。利用 EndoVis18 和 CholecT50，我们将阶段、器械、交互、三元组和分割标签转换为统一上下文，以指导大语言模型生成临床连贯的问答对。MIS-VQA 支持四种响应类型——简洁描述、详细描述、感知级定位和多步推理——从而支持从原子视觉定位到组合推理的分层评估。为解决标注稀疏性问题，我们引入置信度过滤的分割和跨标注一致性检查，实现大规模空间定位监督。MIS-VQA 建立了一个统一基准，用于具有空间监督和多层级推理评估的外科视觉-语言理解。为证明其效用，我们提出 LLaVA-SurgXpert，这是一系列带有视觉编码器的外科视觉-语言模型，用于分析视觉表示如何影响多模态推理。实验表明，相较于现有外科 VQA 基线，其取得了一致提升，同时揭示了先前基准中隐藏的感知定位与更高层推理之间的能力差距。

title: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment (MARCA) of Individual Case Safety Reports in Pharmacovigilance
zh_title: MARCA：药物警戒个例报告的多智能体检索增强因果评价
summary: 构建四智能体RAG框架做Naranjo因果评价，在215份FAERS个例报告上与专家共识标准比较一致性。
key_points: 涵盖文献检索、药品标签、证据分级与临床推理四个智能体
参考标准含1562个药物-事件组合
问题级一致率96.8%，部分kappa偏低
reason: 有人类专家共识参考标准与较大事件组合量，但为预印本且一致性仅中等
abstract: Introduction: Increasing volumes of individual case safety reports (ICSRs) challenge expert-led causality assessment in pharmacovigilance. We developed MARCA (Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment), a four-agent framework for Naranjo-based assessment, and evaluated agreement with human experts and exploratory differences between non-RAG and RAG-labelled scores. Methods: MARCA combined scientific literature retrieval, drug-label assessment, objective-evidence classification, and clinical causality reasoning using Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2. Agent-generated rationales informed human-assisted scoring. A consensus expert reference standard covered 215 ICSRs and 1,562 drug-event combinations (DECs) from FAERS (Q1-Q2 2025). Agreement was measured using percentage agreement and Cohen's kappa. Results: Question-level agreement was 96.8% for Naranjo Q2 (kappa = 0.491; 95% CI 0.265-0.663), 85.4% for Q5 (kappa = 0.269; 95% CI 0.180-0.340), and 96.8% for Q10 (kappa = 0.922; 95% CI 0.885-0.951). Final causality classification agreement was 79.4% (95% CI 71.8-85.3; kappa = 0.587, 95% CI 0.450-0.690). In a retrospective subset of 60 DECs, agreement was higher for RAG-labelled than non-RAG scores for Q5 (83.3% vs 65.0%) and Q10 (100.0% vs 18.3%). Discussion: MARCA-assisted assessment showed substantial variation in agreement across Naranjo questions, with lower concordance for alternative causes. Retrospective RAG comparisons are exploratory and do not establish prospective effectiveness.
zh_abstract: 【背景】不断增加的个例安全性报告（individual case safety reports, ICSRs）数量对药物警戒中由专家主导的因果关系评估构成挑战。我们开发了 MARCA（Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment），一个用于基于 Naranjo 量表评估的四智能体框架，并评估了其与人类专家的一致性以及非 RAG 与 RAG 标记评分之间的探索性差异。【方法】MARCA 使用 Gemini 2.5 Pro 和 DeepSeek-V3.2，结合了科学文献检索、药品标签评估、客观证据分类和临床因果关系推理。智能体生成的依据为人工辅助评分提供参考。一个共识专家参考标准涵盖了来自 FAERS（2025 年第一季度至第二季度）的 215 份 ICSRs 和 1,562 个药物-事件组合（drug-event combinations, DECs）。一致性使用百分比一致性和 Cohen's kappa 衡量。【结果】问题层面的一致性为：Naranjo Q2 为 96.8%（kappa = 0.491；95% CI 0.265-0.663），Q5 为 85.4%（kappa = 0.269；95% CI 0.180-0.340），Q10 为 96.8%（kappa = 0.922；95% CI 0.885-0.951）。最终因果关系分类一致性为 79.4%（95% CI 71.8-85.3；kappa = 0.587，95% CI 0.450-0.690）。在 60 个 DECs 的回顾性子集中，Q5（83.3% 对 65.0%）和 Q10（100.0% 对 18.3%）的 RAG 标记评分一致性高于非 RAG 评分。【讨论】MARCA 辅助评估显示，不同 Naranjo 问题之间的一致性存在较大差异，替代原因的一致性较低。回顾性 RAG 比较属于探索性，不能确定前瞻性有效性。

title: Clinical Application of Artificial Intelligence Methods in Diagnostic Imaging of Pulmonary Nodules
zh_title: AI结合高分辨率靶向CT鉴别肺结节
summary: 上海东方医院注册万人三中心回顾性观察研究，评估AI深度学习系统鉴别肺结节良恶性。
key_points: 计划纳入约1万例，来自上海三家医院
回顾性多中心观察设计，基于术后病理确诊
主要评价AI诊断准确性与效率，尚无结果

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Shanghai East Hospital; conditions: Pulmonary Nodules, Lung Neoplasms, Lung Diseases; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 10000; status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING] This is a retrospective, multicenter observational study evaluating the clinical value of combining high-resolution (1024×1024 matrix) targeted CT scans with an artificial intelligence (AI) deep learning system to distinguish between benign and malignant pulmonary nodules. By analyzing existing medical records and CT images of adult patients (aged 18 and older) with pulmonary nodules (3-30 mm) who have confirmed diagnoses (via postoperative pathology）, this study aims to assess the diagnostic accuracy and efficiency of the AI system. The study plans to enroll approximately 10,000 cases from three hospitals in Shanghai. The primary goal is to evaluate the AI system's diagnostic performance (such as sensitivity, specificity, and Area Under the ROC Curve) and compare it with the performance of radiologists, ultimately exploring whether this combined approach can provide more accurate clinical diagnoses and reduce unnecessary procedures.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：上海市东方医院（Shanghai East Hospital）；疾病：肺结节、肺肿瘤、肺疾病；类型：观察性（OBSERVATIONAL）；入组人数：10000；状态：ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING（活跃、未招募）] 这是一项回顾性、多中心观察性研究，评估将高分辨率（1024×1024矩阵）靶向CT扫描与人工智能（AI）深度学习系统相结合，用于区分良性和恶性肺结节的临床价值。通过分析已有病历和CT图像，研究对象为年龄18岁及以上、肺结节大小3-30 mm且已通过术后病理确诊的成年患者，本研究旨在评估AI系统的诊断准确性和效率。研究计划从上海三家医院入组约10,000例病例。主要目标是评估AI系统的诊断性能（如敏感度、特异度和ROC曲线下面积），并将其与放射科医师的表现进行比较，最终探索这种联合方法能否提供更准确的临床诊断并减少不必要的操作。

title: Prospective Observational Cohort Study for Predicting Unruptured Intracranial Aneurysm Rupture Risk Using Blood Pressure Variability and 3D Structural Evolution
zh_title: 血压变异性与3D形态预测未破裂动脉瘤破裂
summary: 北京天坛医院登记单中心前瞻观察队列2000例，拟用LSTM与Transformer结合血压变异性及3D形态预测动脉瘤破裂。
key_points: 单中心前瞻性观察队列，计划入组2000例
构建血压变异性与3D形态时间序列数据集
拟与PHASES等传统评分比较

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Beijing Tiantan Hospital; conditions: Unruptured Intracranial Aneurysm, Intracranial Aneurysm Rupture; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 2000; status: RECRUITING] This is a single-center, prospective, longitudinal observational cohort study in adults with unruptured intracranial aneurysms (UIAs) who are managed by conservative observation rather than immediate surgery or endovascular treatment. The study aims to build a time-series dataset combining blood pressure variability (BPV) and three-dimensional (3D) aneurysm morphological evolution, and to develop deep-learning models using long short-term memory (LSTM) and Transformer networks to predict aneurysm rupture risk. A secondary aim is to compare the new models with traditional scores such as PHASES and to explore how BPV relates to 3D aneurysm change.Participants aged 18-80 years with UIA confirmed by CTA, MRA, or DSA and judged suitable for conservative follow-up will be enrolled consecutively at the study site. Those with imaging contraindications, other major cerebrovascular diseases such as moyamoya or arteriovenous malformation, or severe organ dysfunction are excluded. No study-driven intervention is imposed; routine clinical care continues. Baseline data include demographics, hypertension history, laboratory tests, 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure, home blood pressure for 7 days, optional wearable monitoring, and CTA/MRA/DSA for 3D aneurysm parameters such as volume, surface area, compactness, and sphericity. BPV is summarized using standard deviation, coefficient of variation, and variability independent of the mean.Participants scheduled for in-hospital visits provide written informed consent and are followed at 6, 12, 24, 36, 48, 72, 96, and 120 months with repeated BPV measurement and imaging. Participants who already have at least two qualifying imaging and blood-pressure records before enrollment and will not return for in-person visits provide verbal consent and are followed by telephone every 6-12 months to confirm health status and rupture/growth events. All data are entered into a REDCap system with automated and manual quality checks. A historical institutional dataset (CAIASA) may be used only for algorithm pretraining and is not counted as the prospective enrollment target.The primary outcome is UIA rupture confirmed by CT or surgery. abstract: [Medical sciences (Basel, Switzerland)] Salivary-gland biopsy is central to Sjögren's disease (SjD) assessment, but conventional measures incompletely capture glandular heterogeneity. This systematic review evaluated artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML) applications to SjD salivary-gland histopathology and molecular profiling, including biological and translational validation. PubMed, Scopus, and Embase were searched. Eligible studies used salivary-gland tissue as the primary analytical substrate or provided substantive glandular validation of systemic AI/ML findings. Evidence was synthesized functionally because of methodological heterogeneity. Twenty-five studies were included. AI/ML identified histopathological and molecular phenotypes spanning immune/interferon activation, tissue architecture and immune-cell organization, epithelial stress and metabolic/cell-death remodeling, and translational response. Only a limited subset progressed beyond computational or tissue-level confirmation to functional perturbation, pharmacological testing, in vivo validation, or human treatment-response assessment. Recurrent public-dataset reuse, small cohorts, heterogeneous pipelines, and limited independent validation constrained reproducibility. AI/ML supports multidimensional SjD glandular phenotyping and shows emerging translational potential, but demonstrated clinical or therapeutic utility remains unestablished. Prospective multicenter validation is required before AI-derived glandular phenotypes can inform routine patient stratification or therapeutic decision-making.

abstract: [The Journal of international medical research] Hepatitis remains a major global health challenge and an important contributor to liver fibrosis, cirrhosis, hepatocellular carcinoma, and liver-related mortality worldwide. Early diagnosis, effective treatment selection, and accurate prognostic stratification remain critical unmet needs in clinical hepatology. Artificial intelligence, particularly machine learning and deep learning, has emerged as a promising approach to addressing these challenges through the integration and analysis of large-scale, heterogeneous biomedical datasets. This narrative review synthesizes advances in artificial intelligence applications in hepatitis research and clinical practice published over the past decade, organized across three clinical domains: diagnosis, treatment optimization, and prognosis prediction. In the diagnostic domain, artificial intelligence-based approaches have been applied to medical imaging, digital pathology, and multi-omics data to enhance the detection, classification, and staging of liver disease. In the therapeutic domain, machine learning models have been increasingly deployed to support drug discovery, optimize therapeutic regimens, and predict individual treatment responses. In the prognostic domain, artificial intelligence-driven models have shown promising performance in predicting disease progression, survival outcomes, and clinical complications. Nevertheless, key limitations persist, including data heterogeneity, limited external generalizability, and barriers to clinical translation. Future progress will depend on prospective multicenter evaluation, use of interoperable multimodal data, development of transparent models that account for uncertainty, and evidence that artificial intelligence improves clinical decisions and patient outcomes rather than performance metrics alone.
zh_abstract: [The Journal of international medical research] 肝炎仍是全球重大健康挑战，也是全球肝纤维化、肝硬化、肝细胞癌和肝脏相关死亡率的重要贡献因素。早期诊断、有效治疗选择以及准确预后分层仍是临床肝病学中关键的未满足需求。人工智能，特别是机器学习和深度学习，已通过整合和分析大规模、异质性生物医学数据集，成为应对这些挑战的有前景的方法。本叙述性综述综合了过去十年发表的肝炎研究和临床实践中人工智能应用进展，按三个临床领域组织：诊断、治疗优化和预后预测。在诊断领域，基于人工智能的方法已应用于医学影像、数字病理学和多组学数据，以增强肝脏疾病的检测、分类和分期。在治疗领域，机器学习模型越来越多地被部署用于支持药物发现、优化治疗方案和预测个体治疗反应。在预后领域，人工智能驱动的模型在预测疾病进展、生存结局和临床并发症方面显示出有前景的表现。然而，关键局限性仍然存在，包括数据异质性、外部泛化性有限以及临床转化障碍。未来进展将取决于前瞻性多中心评估、可互操作多模态数据的使用、考虑不确定性的透明模型的开发，以及证明人工智能改善临床决策和患者结局而不仅仅是性能指标的证据。

abstract: [Experimental parasitology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being investigated to address challenges in parasite detection, disease surveillance, and therapeutic development. This narrative review examines current and emerging AI applications in parasitology across diagnostics, drug discovery, genomics, epidemiology, education, and public health decision-making, with particular emphasis on diagnostic applications. Machine learning and deep learning methods support automated parasite detection, classification, and quantification in microscopic images, alongside medical image analysis and arthropod identification. Applications are discussed for malaria, leishmaniasis, schistosomiasis, cystic echinococcosis, soil-transmitted helminth infections, and intestinal protozoal infections. Beyond diagnosis, AI-assisted approaches support compound screening, drug repurposing, toxicity prediction, and prioritization of potential therapeutic targets. Genomic and transcriptomic analyses also offer opportunities to investigate parasite biology and predict drug resistance. Surveillance models may inform outbreak forecasting and targeted control, although their operational value requires evaluation in the intended settings. Educational applications remain emerging, and the benefits of digital learning should be distinguished from those attributable specifically to AI. Across these domains, performance on curated datasets does not establish clinical utility or generalizability. Major barriers include limited representative datasets, insufficient external and prospective validation, infrastructure constraints, and concerns regarding privacy, bias, and accountability. Future progress requires reproducible evaluation, experimental validation of therapeutic candidates, and assessment of clinical and public health benefits. AI is therefore best positioned as a complementary tool that supports parasitological expertise, with responsible implementation guided by transparency, equitable access, and human oversight.

abstract: [Chemical reviews] Peptide-based therapeutics are gaining popularity as next-generation drugs because of their potent bioactivity, high specificity, and broad applications in immunomodulatory, antiviral, anticancer, and antimicrobial therapy. Membrane-active peptides (MAPs) are particularly promising, yet poor solubility, stability, pharmacokinetics, manufacturing complexity, and limited delivery options have restricted their clinical translation. This review focuses on computational approaches developed to address these challenges at the peptide-design stage and bridge the gap between preclinical promise and clinical utility. The goal here is to provide a broad overview of tools for in silico MAP design, prediction of functional structural ensembles and physicochemical properties, structure-function relationships, drug-target interactions, and formulation strategies for in vivo delivery. These approaches span bioinformatics, molecular dynamics and molecular modeling, and emerging artificial intelligence and machine learning platforms, including hybrid computational-experimental strategies, chemical modification and conjugation, and nanotechnology-based delivery systems. These tools are improving key peptide-drug properties, including plasma stability, target specificity, efficacy, and delivery. Continued advances in computational design may enable MAPs to address challenging diseases, engage traditionally undruggable targets, and translate their substantial therapeutic potential into clinically effective treatments.

abstract: [ACS synthetic biology] Enzyme enantioselectivity remains a central challenge in the biocatalytic synthesis of chiral pharmaceuticals and fine chemicals. Conventional evolution methods, constrained by prolonged experimental cycles and computationally intensive processes, struggle to comprehensively explore complex protein sequences. Although machine learning (ML) has been successfully applied to optimize enzymatic properties, such as catalytic efficiency and stability, its potential in enantioselectivity engineering remains underexploited. This review systematically evaluates how machine learning integrates multimodal datasets, including sequence, structural, and functional performance data, to advance the discovery and engineering of naturally enantioselective enzymes, and enable the de novo design of artificial enzymes for reaction-relevant applications. Furthermore, key algorithmic frameworks are reviewed. Persistent challenges such as data heterogeneity and limited model generalization capabilities are also critically examined. Moreover, machine learning is increasingly expected to bridge molecular-level enantioselective design with pathway optimization and reactor-scale process engineering, enabling a more integrated and efficient chiral biomanufacturing pipeline. Overall, these advancements open new avenues for efficient chiral biosynthesis and provide theoretical foundations and technical blueprints for a paradigm shift toward intelligence-driven biocatalysis engineering.
zh_abstract: [ACS synthetic biology] 酶对映选择性仍然是手性药物和精细化学品生物催化合成中的核心挑战。传统进化方法受实验周期长和计算密集型过程的限制，难以全面探索复杂的蛋白质序列。尽管机器学习（ML）已成功应用于优化酶特性，如催化效率和稳定性，但其在对映选择性工程中的潜力仍未得到充分开发。本综述系统评估了机器学习如何整合多模态数据集，包括序列、结构和功能性能数据，以推进天然对映选择性酶的发现与工程改造，并实现用于反应相关应用的人工酶从头设计。此外，综述了关键算法框架。还批判性审视了数据异质性和模型泛化能力有限等持续存在的挑战。此外，机器学习日益被期望将分子水平的对映选择性设计与途径优化及反应器规模过程工程相衔接，从而实现更集成、更高效的手性生物制造流程。总体而言，这些进展为高效手性生物合成开辟了新途径，并为向智能驱动的生物催化工程范式转变提供了理论基础和技术蓝图。

abstract: Objective: To reduce bias and improve precision in survival association studies using electronic health record (EHR) data when computational phenotypes (CPs) for outcomes and covariates are error-prone and chart review is limited. Materials and Methods: We developed Multivariate Augmented Prediction-Powered Survival (MAPS) regression, which combines chart-reviewed and CP-derived labels across different validation patterns. MAPS uses a discrete-time survival model with a complementary log-log link to estimate hazard ratios (HRs). It incorporates data-adaptive augmentation weights, inverse-probability sampling weights, and patient-level cluster-robust variance estimation. We compared MAPS with chart-reviewed data (CRD) and CP-only analyses in simulation studies and a masked-validation study of immune-related adverse events (irAEs) among 1,026 patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitors. Results: In the main simulations, MAPS produced approximately unbiased estimates and generally near-nominal 95% confidence interval (CI) coverage, with narrower intervals than CRD. CP-only estimates became increasingly biased as CP errors increased. In the EHR analysis, MAPS estimates closely agreed with fully validated estimates and improved precision over CRD, particularly at lower validation rates. CP-only analysis suggested increased irAE risk associated with pre-existing autoimmune disease (AID; HR=1.53; 95% CI, 1.12-2.09), whereas the fully validated analysis did not (HR=0.93; 95% CI, 0.67-1.29). Discussion: Precision gains depended on CP quality and validation rates, while small validation samples may affect confidence interval coverage. Conclusion: MAPS provides a flexible and efficient approach to EHR-based survival inference by combining limited chart-reviewed data with error-prone CPs across different validation patterns.

This understanding can support evidence-based population health policy and processes. Influenza and other acute respiratory diseases place a large, inequitable burden on the New Zealand population and health care resources. We have developed and evaluated models using retrospective New Zealand hospitalisation records linked to other administrative data. Methods: We analysed linked annual records for approximately 4.85 - 5.36 million people in 2017 - 2024. For each year, models were trained to distinguish people who experienced at least one hospitalisation associated with respiratory infectious disease from those without such a hospitalisation during that year. Six algorithms and eight variable sets were assessed using five-fold cross-validation grouped by demographic profile. Variables comprised demographics, continuous hospital-based (M3) and pharmaceutical-based (P3) morbidity indices, and influenza vaccination status. Models trained on one year were also evaluated on data from the following year. Performance measures were the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) and the average precision score (APS). title: flodl-bio: First Rust data, transformers and model layer for entire deep learning on biological sequences
zh_title: Rust生物序列深度学习库flodl-bio
summary: 发布基于libtorch的Rust crate，提供生物序列编码、FASTA解析、图构建、AUROC/AUPRC指标与MEME motif导出。
key_points: 首个覆盖生物序列深度学习的Rust crate

abstract: Python ecosystem dominates the deep learning framework. flodl-bio is a Rust crate that extends flodl, a libtorch-backed deep-learning framework, with deep learning on biological sequences. To our knowledge, flodl-bio is the first Rust crate that provides a comprehensive and practical deep learning for the biological applications, which includes the alphabet-aware sequence encoding, including one-hot and k-mer representations, padded sequences, and channels-first batches. It also includes several FASTA parsing and graph construction utilities for adjacency matrices, GCN-normalised adjacency matrices, graph Laplacians, residue contact maps, and de Bruijn graphs. Among the added functionalities, it includes AUROC and AUPRC with their associated curves; classification metrics, and the export of learned convolutional filters as MEME motifs and seeded splits. Deep biological learning includes a multi-width motif CNN, a dilated residual CNN, bidirectional LSTM and GRU architectures, and transformer encoder. On the five human transcription-factor-binding datasets in the GUE benchmark, a motif CNN with approximately 10,000 parameters, trained from scratch, outperforms all published CNN baselines. It also superseded the 2.5-billion-parameter Nucleotide Transformer on two datasets and DNABERT-2 on one. Given a fixed hardware configuration and software stack, experiments are reproducible at the bit level. See Supplementary Table S2 of Supplementary Material. flodl-bio is written in Rust and released under the MIT licence at https://github.com/sablokg/flodl-bio. The core builds with stable Rust and has no dependencies. The model tier is enabled with the flodl Cargo feature (cuda for NVIDIA GPUs) and requires libtorch and Rust 1.91 or later. The evaluation harness is in the repository's experiments directory, and the complete run outputs are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23321850

abstract: Background: Estimates of generative artificial intelligence (AI) use in the medical literature vary widely, potentially reflecting differences across journals. We estimated changes in the prevalence of AI-generated writing over time using abstracts from 12 general medical journals. Methods: We randomly sampled up to 200 abstracts per journal-year from publications dated January 1, 2020, through August 8, 2026. Abstracts were scored using GPTZero, with journal-specific thresholds calibrated to fix a 1% false-positive rate (FPR) in the pre-AI baseline period (2020-2021). We estimated annual detector-positive proportions and calculated a publication-volume-weighted estimate across sampled journals. Associations with journal impact factor, publication model, and publication volume were examined descriptively. Results: Among 15,268 abstracts, estimated prevalence of AI-generated text increased after 2022, with substantial variation in timing and magnitude across journals. In 2026 through August 8, prevalence estimates ranged from 5.7% (95% CI, 2.1%-10.0%) in the New England Journal of Medicine to 83.5% (95% CI, 77.1%-87.5%) in Frontiers in Medicine. The publication-volume-weighted estimate across sampled journals was 66.7% (95% CI, 64.0%-69.2%), and trends were insensitive to specification of false-positive rate in baseline data. The proportion of abstracts showing signs of AI-generated text was lower in journals with higher impact factors and higher in fully open-access journals. Conclusions: Estimated prevalence of AI-generated text increased substantially across all sampled medical journals, with marked between-journal differences associated with journal impact factor and publication model. These findings support development of standardized, transparent AI reporting in medical publishing.
zh_abstract: 【背景】医学文献中生成式人工智能（AI）使用情况的估计差异很大，可能反映了不同期刊之间的差异。我们使用 12 种综合医学期刊的摘要，估计了 AI 生成写作的流行率随时间的变化。【方法】我们从日期为 2020 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 8 月 8 日的出版物中，每年每刊随机抽取最多 200 篇摘要。摘要使用 GPTZero 评分，并采用期刊特异性阈值进行校准，以在 AI 前基线期（2020-2021 年）将假阳性率（FPR）固定为 1%。我们估计了年度检测器阳性比例，并计算了跨抽样期刊的、按发表量加权的估计值。对与期刊影响因子、出版模式和发表量的关联进行了描述性分析。【结果】在 15,268 篇摘要中，AI 生成文本的估计流行率在 2022 年后上升，且不同期刊在时间趋势和幅度上存在显著差异。2026 年至 8 月 8 日期间，流行率估计从《New England Journal of Medicine》的 5.7%（95% CI，2.1%-10.0%）到《Frontiers in Medicine》的 83.5%（95% CI，77.1%-87.5%）不等。跨抽样期刊的发表量加权估计值为 66.7%（95% CI，64.0%-69.2%），且趋势对基线数据中假阳性率设定不敏感。在影响因子较高的期刊中，显示 AI 生成文本迹象的摘要比例较低；在完全开放获取期刊中则较高。【结论】在所有抽样医学期刊中，AI 生成文本的估计流行率大幅上升，且期刊间差异显著，并与期刊影响因子和出版模式相关。这些发现支持在医学出版中制定标准化、透明的 AI 报告规范。

abstract: Reusing pretrained medical-imaging models offers an alternative to training from scratch. A model trained for the same task may perform poorly at a new hospital because imaging protocols and preprocessing differ. Effective adaptation depends on the model architecture, domain shift, and available labels and compute. Adaptation can improve scores on a small labeled set yet reduce performance on unseen data. We present MedAdaptAgent, an automatic harness that turns a supplied model, target data, and a free-text request into a new-site adaptation workflow. Its LLM-driven Adaptation Planner uses model-site evidence to choose compatible experiments and revise subsequent adjustments. The harness requires evidence of improvement over the pretrained model, then delivers the selected model as a complete, runnable package. Evaluation spans 26 segmentation and classification transfers across architectures and compute settings, with segmentation annotation budgets ranging from zero-shot transfer to few-shot adaptation. With 20 local annotations, mean segmentation Dice rises from 0.483 to 0.774 across 10 transfers, a 60.1% relative gain, with no harmful replacements. Mean classification AUROC rises from 0.810 to 0.837 across 13 transfers, a 3.4% relative gain. Comparing adapted models with the pretrained model reduces harmful classification replacements by 30.8% versus selecting the highest-scoring model on the available labels, using identical candidates. Seven public-model deployments demonstrate adaptation and reproducible package delivery across contrast and modality shifts. A CT-to-MRI study extends the evaluation to four LLM planners, including two open-weight models. We release the code on GitHub.
zh_abstract: 复用预训练医学影像模型为从头训练提供了一种替代方案。为同一任务训练的模型在新医院可能表现不佳，因为成像方案和预处理不同。有效适应取决于模型架构、领域偏移以及可用的标签和算力。适应可以在小型标注集上提高分数，却可能降低在未见数据上的性能。我们提出 MedAdaptAgent，这是一个自动执行框架（harness），可将提供的模型、目标数据和自由文本请求转化为新站点适应工作流。其由 LLM 驱动的 Adaptation Planner 使用模型-站点证据来选择兼容实验，并修订后续调整。该框架要求有证据表明相对于预训练模型有所改进，然后将所选模型作为完整、可运行的包交付。评估涵盖跨架构和计算设置的 26 项分割和分类迁移，分割标注预算从零样本迁移到少样本适应不等。在 20 个本地标注下，10 项迁移的平均分割 Dice 从 0.483 升至 0.774，相对增益 60.1%，且无有害替换。13 项迁移的平均分类 AUROC 从 0.810 升至 0.837，相对增益 3.4%。在相同候选模型下，与根据可用标签选择最高分模型相比，将适应模型与预训练模型进行比较可使有害分类替换减少 30.8%。七项公共模型部署展示了跨对比度和模态偏移的适应及可复现包交付。一项 CT 到 MRI 的研究将评估扩展到四种 LLM 规划器，包括两个开放权重模型。我们在 GitHub 上发布代码。

title: A Knowledge Database of Physical Activity Interventions for Hypertension using Large Language Models

abstract: Physical exercise lowers blood pressure, but guidelines address broad populations and rarely consider age, comorbidities, medications or baseline severity. No structured, queryable database of exercise interventions for hypertension exists, and manual curation is not scalable. We present PAHD (Physical Activity for Hypertension Database), built with large language models (LLMs). An LLM screened 2,548 PubMed records by title and abstract, then full text, selecting 255 studies. LLMs extracted each study's groups, exercise protocols, patient characteristics and results; two LLMs cross-checked the study structure, and every value carries a verbatim quote. Code standardized and joined the extractions into 17,312 records from 254 studies, one per reported comparison. Against adjudicated benchmarks, screening reached 86.3% recall and 80.6% precision, and extraction recovered 90.1% of blood pressure values with 90.5% precision. A web portal matches patients' hypertension stage and comorbidities to studies. PAHD provides a structured evidence base for personalized exercise interventions on hypertension management.
zh_abstract: 体育锻炼可降低血压，但指南针对广泛人群，很少考虑年龄、合并症、药物或基线严重程度。尚无针对高血压运动干预的结构化、可查询数据库，且人工整理不可扩展。我们提出了 PAHD（Physical Activity for Hypertension Database，高血压身体活动数据库），其使用大语言模型（LLMs）构建。一个大语言模型通过标题和摘要筛选 2,548 条 PubMed 记录，然后筛选全文，最终选择 255 项研究。大语言模型提取每项研究的分组、运动方案、患者特征和结果；两个大语言模型交叉核对研究结构，每个数值均附有逐字引文。代码对提取结果进行标准化并连接，形成来自 254 项研究的 17,312 条记录，每项报告的比较对应一条记录。对照经裁定的基准，筛选达到 86.3% 的召回率和 80.6% 的精确率，提取回收了 90.1% 的血压值，精确率为 90.5%。一个网络门户将患者的高血压分期和合并症与研究相匹配。PAHD 为高血压管理中的个性化运动干预提供了结构化证据基础。
