abstract: We present an automated image-based framework for quantifying biomarker expression in immunohistochemical (IHC) images and introduce the Marker Expression Level (MEL) score as an objective alternative to visual H-scoring. MEL addresses key limitations of existing automated methods by integrating tissue-region segmentation with tumour-area-weighted marker quantification, normalization to mitigate inter-sample and inter-batch staining variability, and robust quantification of nuclear, cytoplasmic, and membrane-associated biomarkers. The complete pipeline was developed as an open-source Fiji/ImageJ tool and is publicly available. We evaluated MEL using IHC images from 128 lung adenocarcinoma patients stained for BRCA1, GLUT1, and QKI, three markers forming a prognostic signature previously described by our group. Tissue regions were segmented using a machine learning-based Fiji plugin, and MEL scores were calculated within tumour regions. A normalization strategy accounted for inter-TMA staining variability. Agreement with visual H-scores was assessed using Spearman correlation. Prognostic performance was evaluated using Cox regression to derive a Combined Prognostic Index (CPI) incorporating MEL scores and tumour stage. Segmentation achieved high accuracy across tissue regions (Dice coefficients 0.69-0.99), with lower performance in highly immune-infiltrated stromal areas. MEL scores significantly correlated with visual H-scores for all markers ({rho} = 0.61-0.69, p < 0.001). Normalization improved agreement for GLUT1 ({rho} = 0.39 to 0.62). The derived CPI stratified patients into distinct risk groups with significant differences in disease-free and overall survival (p < 0.05), comparable to visual scoring. MEL provides a reproducible and scalable alternative to expert visual H-scoring and standard semi-automated approaches such as QuPath. Its integration with prognostic modelling reproduced a validated survival signature with performance comparable to expert scoring, supporting clinical and translational applicability. MEL is not a marginal refinement of existing digital scoring methods, but rather a clinically oriented and biologically adaptable framework designed to improve the robustness and reproducibility of automated IHC quantification.
zh_abstract: 我们提出一个基于图像的自动化框架，用于量化免疫组织化学（IHC）图像中的生物标志物表达，并引入标志物表达水平（MEL）评分，作为视觉 H 评分的客观替代方案。MEL 通过整合组织区域分割与肿瘤面积加权的标志物定量、用于减轻样本间和批次间染色变异性的归一化，以及对核、细胞质和膜相关生物标志物的稳健定量，解决了现有自动化方法的关键局限。完整流程已开发为开源 Fiji/ImageJ 工具并公开可用。我们使用 128 例肺腺癌患者的 IHC 图像评估 MEL，这些图像针对 BRCA1、GLUT1 和 QKI 染色，这三种标志物构成本课题组先前描述的预后特征。组织区域使用基于机器学习的 Fiji 插件进行分割，并在肿瘤区域内计算 MEL 评分。一种归一化策略考虑了 TMA 间染色变异性。与视觉 H 评分的一致性使用 Spearman 相关评估。预后性能使用 Cox 回归评估，以推导纳入 MEL 评分和肿瘤分期的联合预后指数（CPI）。分割在各组织区域达到高准确度（Dice 系数 0.69—0.99），但在高度免疫浸润的间质区域性能较低。所有标志物的 MEL 评分均与视觉 H 评分显著相关（{rho} = 0.61—0.69，p < 0.001）。归一化改善了 GLUT1 的一致性（{rho} = 0.39 至 0.62）。推导出的 CPI 将患者分层为不同风险组，其无病生存和总生存差异显著（p < 0.05），与视觉评分相当。MEL 为专家视觉 H 评分和 QuPath 等标准半自动化方法提供了一种可重复且可扩展的替代方案。其与预后建模的整合再现了一个经过验证的生存特征，性能与专家评分相当，支持临床和转化应用。MEL 并非现有数字评分方法的边际改进，而是一个面向临床且具有生物学适应性的框架，旨在提高自动化 IHC 定量的稳健性和可重复性。

title: A Pipeline for Predicting Variant Associations with Complex Disorders via Functional Annotations
zh_title: 基于功能注释预测复杂疾病变异关联的流程
summary: 提出可复现流程，整合GWAS汇总统计与CADD注释生成复杂疾病变异数据集。
key_points: GWAS变异数据异质、不适于直接机器学习
流程含基因组映射与按染色体分层负采样
按EFO术语定义复杂疾病构建可复现数据集
reason: 预印本数据流程工作，未见下游模型性能验证，属增量档
abstract: The study of complex disorders is limited by the lack of structured data sets that integrate genetic association signals with rich functional annotations. While genome wide association studies (GWAS) provide large collections of associated variants, these are heterogeneous, studydependent, and not directly suitable for machine learning applications. Although frameworks such as Combined Annotation Dependent Depletion (CADD) offer comprehensive variant-level features, there is no standardised procedure to construct curated, balanced, and reproducible data sets for the systematic study of complex traits. We introduce a scalable and reproducible pipeline for generating CADD-annotated variant data sets associated with complex disorders defined via Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) terms. The pipeline integrates GWAS summary statistics, genome mapping, chromosomestratified negative sampling, and large-scale annotation, while addressing class imbalance and feature redundancy. The resulting data sets provide curated, balanced, and annotation-rich representations of variant-trait associations, suitable for statistical learning, systematic model evaluation and comparison, and analysis of functional annotation contributions and interactions.
zh_abstract: 复杂疾病的研究受限于缺乏将遗传关联信号与丰富功能注释整合的结构化数据集。虽然全基因组关联研究（GWAS）提供了大量关联变异集合，但这些变异具有异质性、依赖研究，并且不直接适用于机器学习应用。尽管Combined Annotation Dependent Depletion（CADD）等框架提供了全面的变异水平特征，但尚无标准化流程来构建经整理、平衡且可重复的数据集，以用于复杂性状的系统研究。我们提出一种可扩展且可重复的流程，用于生成与通过实验因子本体（EFO）术语定义的复杂疾病相关的CADD注释变异数据集。该流程整合GWAS汇总统计量、基因组映射、按染色体分层的负采样和大规模注释，同时处理类别不平衡和特征冗余。所得数据集提供了经整理、平衡且注释丰富的变异-性状关联表示，适用于统计学习、系统模型评估与比较，以及功能注释贡献和相互作用的分析。

title: Automated Sleep Staging Performance Across Two Experimental Sleep Manipulation Protocols in Adolescents.
zh_title: 青少年睡眠操纵方案下自动睡眠分期性能评估
summary: 预印本在睡眠限制与慢波睡眠剥夺两个方案中检验POPS、YASA等自动睡眠分期算法对青少年多导睡眠图的判读效度。
key_points: 两方案样本分别为43例与18例
对照人工判读评估POPS、YASA及组合
关注睡眠结构被干预时算法是否稳定
reason: 小样本、单中心预印本效度研究，仅比较算法与人工判读
abstract: Automated sleep staging algorithms improve the scalability of polysomnography analysis in adolescent research but are primarily validated in undisturbed, single-night sleep recordings. It remains unclear whether these algorithms maintain performance when sleep architecture is experimentally manipulated. This study evaluated the validity of two popular automated sleep staging approaches across two distinct sleep manipulation paradigms in adolescents: a sleep restriction protocol (N=43, mean age [SD]=13.37[1.06] years; four nights including two sleep extension [10hr] and two restriction [4hr] nights) and a slow-wave sleep deprivation (SWSD) protocol (N=18, mean age [SD]=17.17[1.79] years; baseline, SWSD, and recovery nights). Automated sleep staging was performed using the POPulation-level Sleep Stager (POPS), the Yet Another Spindle Algorithm (YASA), and combined POPS+YASA. Manual polysomnography scoring by experienced sleep technicians served as the reference standard. Agreement was assessed using Cohen's k, and stage-specific performance was evaluated using F1 scores and confusion matrices. Mixed-effects models tested differences in overall and stage-specific agreement across nights. All staging approaches demonstrated moderate-to-substantial agreement with manual scoring across manipulated sleep conditions (k range; range=0.53-0.76). In the sleep restriction study, agreement was lower in restricted versus extended sleep (P<0.05), and agreement declined across restriction nights, with poorer Wake, N1, and N2 classification, while N3 remained preserved. In the SWSD study, overall agreement was lower on the SWSD night, with poorer N3 classification while other stages were preserved. Automated sleep staging performance may be less consistent in adolescents when sleep is curtailed or fragmented; future studies should develop and validate these algorithms under multiple sleep conditions.
zh_abstract: 自动睡眠分期算法提高了青少年研究中多导睡眠图分析的可扩展性，但主要在未受干扰的单夜睡眠记录中得到验证。目前尚不清楚当睡眠结构受到实验性操纵时，这些算法能否保持性能。本研究在青少年中两种不同的睡眠操纵范式中评估了两种常用自动睡眠分期方法的有效性：一项睡眠限制方案（N=43，平均年龄[SD]=13.37[1.06]岁；四个夜晚包括两个睡眠延长（10小时）夜和两个睡眠限制（4小时）夜）和一项慢波睡眠剥夺（SWSD）方案（N=18，平均年龄[SD]=17.17[1.79]岁；基线夜、SWSD 夜和恢复夜）。自动睡眠分期使用群体水平睡眠分期器（POPulation-level Sleep Stager，POPS）、另一种纺锤波算法（Yet Another Spindle Algorithm，YASA）以及 POPS+YASA 联合进行。由经验丰富的睡眠技师进行的人工多导睡眠图判读作为参考标准。一致性使用 Cohen's k 评估，阶段特异性性能使用 F1 分数和混淆矩阵评估。混合效应模型检验了各夜晚总体一致性和阶段特异性一致性的差异。所有分期方法在受操纵的睡眠条件下均显示与人工判读中等至较高的一致性（k 范围；范围=0.53-0.76）。在睡眠限制研究中，睡眠限制条件下的一致性低于睡眠延长条件（P<0.05），且一致性在连续限制夜中下降，其中清醒（Wake）、N1 和 N2 分类较差，而 N3 保持稳定。在 SWSD 研究中，SWSD 夜总体一致性较低，N3 分类较差，而其他睡眠阶段保持稳定。在青少年中，当睡眠被缩短或碎片化时，自动睡眠分期性能可能较不一致；未来研究应在多种睡眠条件下开发并验证这些算法。

title: Shifted Window Temporal Transformer for YOLO-Guided Phase Recognition in Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Surgery
zh_title: Swin时序Transformer用于腹腔镜胆囊切除手术阶段识别
summary: 结合Swin Transformer与时序编码器做手术阶段识别，并行YOLOv11s定位器械，在Cholec80测试。
key_points: 因果时序平滑抑制阶段预测闪烁
并行YOLOv11s实时器械定位
仅在公开Cholec80数据集评估
reason: 公开数据集上的方法改进，无外部验证与临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Intelligent operating rooms require accurate awareness of surgical workflow for better intra-operative decisions, teamwork, and surgical documentation. Therefore, accurately recognizing surgical phase during surgery is crucial. However, previous artificial intelligence-based methods provide fluctuating predictions for the transitions, restricting their clinical use. To address this challenge, we propose a clinically meaningful framework that integrates a Swin Transformer and Temporal Transformer Encoder (TTE) for effective surgical phase recognition and a parallel YOLOv11s network for real-time surgical instrument localization. To avoid phase flickering and to produce stable workflow predictions, a causal temporal smoothing is applied. The proposed framework is tested on the Cholec80 dataset for the simultaneous recognition of the surgical phases and instruments. The overall phase recognition accuracy of this model was 92%, and the macro average F1-score was 0.86. This performance surpasses CNN based methods such as EndoNet (81.7%) and SV-RCNet (85.3%), as well as temporal convolutional and transformer-based approaches including TeCNO (88.6%), Trans-SVNet (90.9%), and LoViT (91.5%). Besides, the module of instrument detection achieved mAP@0.5 = 0.863. The reliability of the results is confirmed, obtaining a high recognition rate of the workflows, and a high accuracy of the localization of the instruments. The proposed framework can serve as a foundation for intelligent surgical assistance, enriching situation awareness, and potential robotic surgery applications. Code will be made publicly available at: https://github.com/ac005sheekar/LapChol-Surgery-Swin-Cholec80
zh_abstract: 智能手术室需要准确感知手术工作流程，以便改善术中决策、团队协作和手术记录。因此，在手术过程中准确识别手术阶段至关重要。然而，以往基于人工智能的方法对阶段转换给出波动的预测，限制了其临床使用。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一个具有临床意义的框架，该框架整合 Swin Transformer 和时间 Transformer 编码器（Temporal Transformer Encoder，TTE）以实现有效的手术阶段识别，并并行使用 YOLOv11s 网络进行实时手术器械定位。为避免阶段闪烁并产生稳定的工作流程预测，应用了因果时间平滑。所提出的框架在 Cholec80 数据集上测试，用于同时识别手术阶段和器械。该模型的总体阶段识别准确率为 92%，宏平均 F1 分数为 0.86。该性能超过了基于 CNN 的方法，如 EndoNet（81.7%）和 SV-RCNet（85.3%），以及时间卷积和基于 Transformer 的方法，包括 TeCNO（88.6%）、Trans-SVNet（90.9%）和 LoViT（91.5%）。此外，器械检测模块实现了 mAP@0.5 = 0.863。结果可靠性得到确认，工作流程识别率高，器械定位准确性高。所提出的框架可作为智能手术辅助的基础，丰富态势感知，并具有潜在的机器人手术应用。代码将公开提供于：https://github.com/ac005sheekar/LapChol-Surgery-Swin-Cholec80

title: Semantic-Aware Deformable Feature Alignment for Thyroid Nodule Segmentation in Ultrasound
zh_title: 语义感知可变形特征对齐的超声甲状腺结节分割
summary: 提出SDFA-Net，解耦全局语义与局部几何学习，用于超声甲状腺结节分割。
key_points: 聚类线性上下文聚合建模长程依赖
动态原型调制抑制背景干扰
级联空间对齐实现亚像素融合
reason: 单任务分割方法改进，摘要未体现外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Accurate segmentation of thyroid nodules in ultrasound images is essential for clinical diagnosis yet remains challenging due to boundary ambiguity, speckle noise, and complex geometric variability. Existing methods often fail to reconcile global semantic understanding with precise local boundary delineation, leading to errors in irregular cases. To address this, we propose SDFA-Net, a framework built on semantic-aware deformable feature alignment that explicitly decouples the learning of robust global semantics and detailed local geometry. Our approach integrates three main components: a clustered linear context aggregation module for efficient long-range dependency modeling, an affinity-driven token modulation mechanism using dynamic prototypes to suppress background interference, and a cascaded spatially-aligned feature fusion strategy that achieves sub-pixel geometric alignment across multiple resolution stages. By filtering and aligning multi-scale features, SDFA-Net ensures robust fusion that is both semantically meaningful and geometrically accurate. We validate our method through extensive experiments on three public thyroid ultrasound datasets, TN3K, TUCC, and DDTI, where it demonstrates superior performance over state-of-the-art methods. The proposed framework offers a generalizable solution for precise medical image segmentation in boundary-ambiguous scenarios.
zh_abstract: 超声图像中甲状腺结节的准确分割对于临床诊断至关重要，但由于边界模糊、斑点噪声和复杂几何变异性，仍然具有挑战性。现有方法常常无法协调全局语义理解与精确局部边界描绘，导致不规则病例中的错误。为此，我们提出 SDFA-Net，一个基于语义感知可变形特征对齐的框架，显式解耦稳健全局语义与详细局部几何的学习。我们的方法集成三个主要组件：用于高效长程依赖建模的聚类线性上下文聚合模块；使用动态原型抑制背景干扰的亲和力驱动 token 调制机制；以及跨多个分辨率阶段实现亚像素几何对齐的级联空间对齐特征融合策略。通过过滤和对齐多尺度特征，SDFA-Net 确保融合既具有语义意义又具有几何准确性。我们通过在三个公开甲状腺超声数据集 TN3K、TUCC 和 DDTI 上的大量实验验证了我们的方法，其表现出优于最先进方法的性能。所提出的框架为边界模糊场景中的精确医学图像分割提供了一种可泛化的解决方案。

title: StaX-Net: Stackelberg Interleaved Asymmetric Network for Cross-Modality Medical Image Translation
zh_title: StaX-Net：Stackelberg式交错非对称跨模态医学图像翻译网络
summary: 提出StaX-Net，用部分耦合的编码器-判别器结构与FAST层约束跨模态医学图像合成，稳定主从式训练。
key_points: 生成器与判别器共享部分模块以对齐特征
FAST层在训练中蒸馏目标域先验，推理时仅用源域变换
采用非对称学习率与共享参数冻结的优化方案
reason: 方法类预印本，仅摘要层面描述，无外部验证或临床评估，属增量档
abstract: Cross-modality medical image translation is challenged by anatomically inconsistent synthesis that can compromise clinical diagnosis. We propose StaX-Net, a Stackelberg interleaved asymmetric network that incorporates a partially coupled encoder-discriminator structure, and a 2D feature aggregation and spatial transformation (FAST) layer that distills target-supervised priors under the learning using privileged information paradigm. The shared blocks between the generator and discriminator enhance architectural feature alignment. To stabilize the leader-follower training, a Stackelberg-inspired asymmetric optimization scheme employs explicit shared-parameter freezing and asymmetric learning rates. The FAST layer distills target-domain priors during training and applies a source-only transform at inference. This constrains the synthesis process through target-informed feature representations relative to standard generative architectures. The code is available on GitHub for public use.
zh_abstract: 跨模态医学图像转换受到解剖上不一致的合成结果的挑战，这可能危及临床诊断。我们提出 StaX-Net，一种 Stackelberg 交错非对称网络，其包含部分耦合的编码器-判别器结构，以及一个 2D 特征聚合与空间变换（feature aggregation and spatial transformation, FAST）层，该层在学习使用特权信息（learning using privileged information）范式下蒸馏目标监督先验。生成器与判别器之间的共享块增强了架构特征对齐。为稳定领导者-跟随者训练，一种受 Stackelberg 启发的非对称优化方案采用显式共享参数冻结和非对称学习率。FAST 层在训练期间蒸馏目标域先验，并在推理时应用仅源域变换。相对于标准生成架构，这通过目标信息引导的特征表示约束合成过程。代码已在 GitHub 上公开可用。

title: Energy Efficient Lung Tumor Segmentation with a modified CBAM ENet Skip Model
zh_title: 改进CBAM ENet的轻量能效肺肿瘤分割模型
summary: 预印本提出基于ENet加UNet跳连与CBAM的轻量肺肿瘤分割模型，强调低算力与实时推理。
key_points: ENet主干加UNet式跳连与CBAM注意力
面向低算力与快速推理的临床部署
在TCIA/医学分割十项挑战公开数据上训练
reason: 现有架构组合的增量改进，公开数据但无外部验证或多中心评估
abstract: Lung tumor segmentation plays a vital role in early detection and treatment planning of lung cancer. Although state-of-the-art deep learning models achieve high dice score coefficients (DSC), each forward pass requires computing large amounts of floating point operations, making them computationally expensive, requiring GPU acceleration, and having slow inference speed, limiting real-world clinical deployment. We propose a lightweight, energy-efficient model that leverages the ENet architecture for its real-time inference capability and low computational cost, enhanced with UNet-style skip connections between encoder and decoder stages for feature reuse and the lightweight Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) for improved feature representation. The model is trained on publicly available data from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) via the Medical Segmentation Decathlon Challenge (MSD) and evaluated on the Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative (LIDC-IDRI) dataset. Our model achieves a DSC of 0.90812 (threshold of 0.5) with its compact architecture of 430,052 parameters and 0.549 Giga Multiply-Accumulate operations (GMAC), making it up to 10 times faster, requires 79 times less GMAC than UNet, and has 22 times fewer parameters than SegNet. These characteristics make it well-suited for deployment in clinical settings where computational resources are limited and decrease the cost of utilizing such a system. Additionally, the explainable AI technique of Grad-CAM is used to provide visual interpretability of the model's predictions and to identify regions where segmentation performance requires improvement.
zh_abstract: 肺部肿瘤分割在肺癌的早期检测和治疗规划中起着至关重要的作用。尽管最先进的深度学习模型实现了较高的Dice相似系数（DSC），但每次前向传播都需要计算大量浮点运算，使其计算代价高昂、需要GPU加速且推理速度慢，限制了真实世界中的临床部署。我们提出了一种轻量级、高能效模型，利用ENet架构实现实时推理能力和低计算成本，并通过编码器与解码器阶段之间的UNet风格跳跃连接增强特征复用，以及通过轻量级卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）改善特征表示。该模型通过医学分割十项挑战赛（MSD）使用癌症影像档案（TCIA）的公开数据进行训练，并在肺图像数据库联盟与图像数据库资源计划（LIDC-IDRI）数据集上进行评估。我们的模型在0.5阈值下达到0.90812的DSC，其紧凑架构具有430,052个参数和0.549吉次乘累加运算（GMAC），使其速度最高快10倍、GMAC需求比UNet少79倍，并且参数数量比SegNet少22倍。这些特性使其非常适合部署在计算资源有限的临床环境中，并降低使用此类系统的成本。此外，使用可解释人工智能技术Grad-CAM提供模型预测的视觉可解释性，并识别分割性能需要改进的区域。

title: Words Are the Voice of the Mind: Depression Severity Estimation from Social Traces via Mental-Guided Evidence Reasoning
zh_title: 基于社交媒体痕迹的心理证据推理抑郁严重度估计
summary: 提出UMer框架，通过用户特定心理先验与细粒度心理证据推理，从社交媒体文本估计抑郁严重度。
key_points: 弥补用户特定心理先验建模不足
引入多样化语义检索与证据层面推理
针对传统量表面访需用户主动参与的局限
reason: 方法新颖但仅摘要信息，无外部临床队列或验证描述，属增量档
abstract: Depression severity estimation is crucial for mental health assessment and intervention, yet traditional approaches depend on clinical interviews or self-report questionnaires that require users' active participation. With the widespread use of online social media, users leave rich social traces that may reflect their mental states, motivating the task of social media-based depression severity estimation. Existing efforts have progressed from textual-feature-based classification to LLM-based questionnaire completion over standardized scale items, yet they still fall short in user-specific mental priors modeling, diversified semantic retrieval, and fine-grained reasoning over mental evidence. To address these limitations, we propose UMer, a user-specific mental evidence reasoning framework for social traces-based depression severity estimation. UMer first distills a user-specific mental prior from historical social traces to capture the user's psychological tendencies, behavioral patterns, and self-expression style. It then performs scale-guided multi-query retrieval to construct evidence memories from item-relevant posts. Finally, it conducts coarse-to-fine evidence-aware reasoning to distinguish direct and indirect evidence and predict item-level scores with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that UMer not only achieves competitive performance over existing baselines, but also provides evidence-grounded interpretability and generalizes to other scale-based tasks.
zh_abstract: 抑郁严重程度估计对心理健康评估和干预至关重要，然而传统方法依赖需要用户主动参与的临床访谈或自评问卷。随着在线社交媒体的广泛使用，用户留下可能反映其心理状态的丰富社交痕迹，推动了基于社交媒体的抑郁严重程度估计任务。现有工作已从基于文本特征的分类发展到基于大语言模型（LLM）对标准化量表条目进行问卷作答，但它们在用户特定的心理先验建模、多样化语义检索以及对心理证据的细粒度推理方面仍存在不足。为解决这些局限，我们提出 UMer，一种面向基于社交痕迹的抑郁严重程度估计的用户特定心理证据推理框架。UMer 首先从历史社交痕迹中蒸馏用户特定的心理先验，以捕捉用户的心理倾向、行为模式和自我表达风格。然后执行量表引导的多查询检索，从与条目相关的帖子中构建证据记忆。最后进行由粗到细的证据感知推理，以区分直接证据和间接证据，并借助可解释的理由预测条目级得分。在真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，UMer 不仅在现有基线上取得有竞争力的性能，还提供以证据为依据的可解释性，并可泛化到其他基于量表的任务。

title: Perturbation-Based Data Selection for Medical Question Answering
zh_title: 基于扰动的医学问答数据选择
summary: 研究基于高斯扰动表示信号的医学问答训练子集选择，用MedGemma-4B在五个医学QA数据集上评估RSP与RSP-Drop。
key_points: 利用预测翻转频率与边际收缩
仅用问题与选项做选择
五个医学QA数据集小预算评估
reason: 预印本，方法改进幅度有限、仅内部评测，属增量档。
abstract: Selecting a compact training subset is an important step in adapting medical language models from existing question-answering banks. We investigate perturbation-based data selection using two signals derived from Gaussian perturbations of the final-block representation: prediction-change frequency and non-flipping margin contraction. After a shared entropy prefilter, Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization (RSP) combines the signals using automatic root-mean-square scaling, while RSP-Drop ranks candidates by contraction alone. Both selectors use only questions and answer options during selection. We evaluate them with MedGemma-4B on five medical QA datasets at retained-set budgets of 64, 128, and 256 examples. At the primary budget of 128, RSP and RSP-Drop obtain dataset-averaged Macro-F1 scores of 47.55 and 48.28, respectively, compared with 45.11 for entropy-pool-matched random selection. Their relative performance varies across datasets and budgets. A selected-set case study identifies contrasting clean-margin profiles among the examples exchanged by the two rules, while a full-pool ablation shows that entropy prefiltering is not uniformly beneficial. These retrospective results characterize the empirical utility and limitations of perturbation-based selection under a fixed adaptation protocol. Evaluation uses one backbone and benchmarks with documented training-family overlap; it does not establish clinical effectiveness.
zh_abstract: 在从现有问答库适配医学语言模型时，选择一个紧凑的训练子集是重要步骤。我们研究基于扰动的数据选择，使用源自最终块表示高斯扰动的两个信号：预测变化频率和非翻转边际收缩。经过共享的熵预筛选后，表示敏感性优先排序（RSP）使用自动均方根缩放来组合这些信号，而 RSP-Drop 仅按收缩对候选进行排序。两种选择器在选择过程中都只使用问题和答案选项。我们在五个医学问答数据集上使用 MedGemma-4B 评估它们，保留集预算为 64、128 和 256 个示例。在主要预算 128 下，RSP 和 RSP-Drop 获得的数据集平均 Macro-F1 分数分别为 47.55 和 48.28，而熵池匹配的随机选择为 45.11。它们的相对性能因数据集和预算而异。一项选定集案例研究识别出两种规则所交换示例之间具有对比性的干净边际特征，而全池消融显示熵预过滤并非一致有益。这些回顾性结果刻画了在固定适配协议下基于扰动选择的经验效用和局限性。评估使用一个骨干模型和具有记录的训练家族重叠的基准；它并未确立临床有效性。

title: Promise and Limits of Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation for Lightweight Medical Vision Transformers (LiteMed-ViT)
zh_title: 轻量医学视觉Transformer的跨架构知识蒸馏
summary: 提出LiteMed-ViT，以双令牌蒸馏将CNN教师知识迁移至0.234M参数的轻量ViT学生，用于边缘端医学图像分析。
key_points: 参数比ResNet18教师少47.8倍，内存0.89MB
在三个MedMNIST子集上准确率高于紧凑CNN基线
仅小规模公开数据集验证，无外部临床验证
reason: 小规模基准数据集上的轻量模型改进，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Running deep models for medical image analysis at the point of care is challenging with standard architectures: convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are often too heavy for edge devices, while Vision Transformers (ViTs) require massive training datasets to compensate for missing inductive biases. This study investigates how far the dual-token distillation used to train data-efficient ViTs can be pushed when applied across architectures, from a CNN-based teacher into a lightweight ViT student. LiteMed-ViT is introduced as a dual-token ViT featuring a convolutional stem and a class-balanced distillation objective; at 0.234M parameters, LiteMed-ViT carries 47.8x fewer parameters than its ResNet18 teacher at a memory footprint of just 0.89 MB. Evaluated against three compact CNN baselines on three MedMNIST subsets of varying modality and class balance, LiteMed-ViT attains higher accuracy than all three baselines on BloodMNIST (95.05%) and two on PathMNIST (89.15%). Under MedMNIST-C corruptions, it is at least as robust as every compact CNN across all subsets, outperforming them on BloodMNIST and PathMNIST without declining in relative standing as severity increases. Particular attention is devoted to identifying the exact conditions where performance plateaus. On DermaMNIST, LiteMed-ViT's balanced accuracy remains up to 1.9 points below the strongest compact CNNs and does not benefit from higher input resolutions up to 224 pixels, where ResNet18 gains 12.6 points. Stronger teachers do not yield a more accurate student, and overconfident ones lower its DermaMNIST balanced accuracy unless calibrated.
zh_abstract: 在护理点运行深度模型进行医学图像分析时，标准架构面临挑战：卷积神经网络（CNN）对边缘设备而言往往过于沉重，而视觉Transformer（ViT）需要海量训练数据集来补偿缺失的归纳偏置。本研究探讨用于训练数据高效ViT的双令牌蒸馏在跨架构应用——从基于CNN的教师模型到轻量级ViT学生模型——时能推进到何种程度。引入LiteMed-ViT，一种双令牌ViT，具有卷积主干和类别平衡蒸馏目标；在0.234M参数下，LiteMed-ViT的参数比其ResNet18教师少47.8倍，内存占用仅0.89 MB。在三个模态和类别平衡不同的MedMNIST子集上，与三个紧凑CNN基线相比，LiteMed-ViT在BloodMNIST（95.05%）上准确率高于所有三个基线，在PathMNIST（89.15%）上高于其中两个基线。在MedMNIST-C损坏下，它在所有子集上至少与每个紧凑CNN一样稳健，在BloodMNIST和PathMNIST上优于它们，且随着严重程度增加相对排名不下降。特别关注识别性能平台期的确切条件。在DermaMNIST上，LiteMed-ViT的平衡准确率仍比最强紧凑CNN低多达1.9个百分点，并且从高达224像素的更高输入分辨率中无获益，而ResNet18在此获得12.6个百分点。更强的教师并不会产生更准确的学生，过度自信的教师会降低其DermaMNIST平衡准确率，除非经过校准。

title: VTRL-Med: Progressive Visual Refinement with Topology-Guided Regularization for Medical Image Clustering
zh_title: VTRL-Med：拓扑引导正则的医学图像聚类
summary: 提出VTRL-Med框架，借助SAM提取结构特征并以拓扑引导正则，改善无标注医学图像数据的深度聚类。
key_points: 用适配后的SAM特征保留掩膜预训练的结构线索
引入连通性、孔洞等拓扑模式作为全局几何约束
针对无标注医学图像数据的聚类任务
reason: 方法有新意但无外部验证与临床结局，属预印本方法档
abstract: Deep clustering offers a promising approach for analyzing large unlabeled medical image datasets, yet prevailing methods still face two limitations: they may neglect class-agnostic structural priors that capture object boundaries and regions, and they do not explicitly encode topological patterns (e.g., connectivity and holes). These sources of information play distinct and complementary roles: visual-structural features provide the primary discriminative representation for clustering, while topological features provide additional global geometric cues for residual visual ambiguities. We introduce VTRL-Med, a progressive visual-structural learning framework with topology-guided regularization for medical image clustering. VTRL-Med first adapts the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to extract image features that retain structural cues inherited from mask-supervised pretraining. It then generates reliable pseudo-labels through a two-step filtering process that combines prototype-based selection with k-nearest neighbor consistency validation. Finally, it progressively refines the visual branch while an auxiliary topology branch, constructed from persistent homology (PH) descriptors, provides additional geometric regularization during training. Across 13 medical image benchmarks, VTRL-Med achieves state-of-the-art clustering performance, improving average accuracy by 4.48% over existing methods. On three representative datasets, topology-guided regularization further improves accuracy by 1.3--4.3% over visual refinement alone.
zh_abstract: 深度聚类为分析大型无标签医学图像数据集提供了一种有前景的方法，但现有方法仍面临两个局限：它们可能忽略捕获对象边界和区域的类别无关结构先验，并且没有显式编码拓扑模式（如连通性和孔洞）。这些信息来源发挥不同且互补的作用：视觉-结构特征提供聚类的主要判别表示，而拓扑特征为残余视觉歧义提供额外的全局几何线索。我们提出VTRL-Med，一种用于医学图像聚类的、带拓扑引导正则化的渐进式视觉-结构学习框架。VTRL-Med首先适配Segment Anything Model（SAM）以提取保留从掩码监督预训练继承的结构线索的图像特征。然后，它通过两步过滤过程生成可靠伪标签，该过程结合基于原型的选择与k近邻一致性验证。最后，它逐步细化视觉分支，同时由持续同调（PH）描述子构建的辅助拓扑分支在训练期间提供额外几何正则化。在13个医学图像基准上，VTRL-Med实现最先进聚类性能，较现有方法平均准确率提高4.48%。在三个代表性数据集上，拓扑引导正则化较仅视觉细化进一步提高准确率1.3--4.3%。

title: Every Edge Needs a Quote: Building a Quote-Grounded Knowledge Graph of Healthcare Software Adoption with Language-Model Agents
zh_title: 每条边需有引文：智能体构建医疗软件采用知识图谱
summary: 用确定性爬取加预算受限ReAct智能体，从公开网页抽取医院软件客户与集成关系，要求每条边有逐字引文支撑。
key_points: 规则要求每条关系边均有源页面逐字引文支持
结合厂商站点确定性爬取与网页搜索智能体
目标是核验同级机构采用某软件的可信证据
reason: 预印本方法思路清晰但场景较窄、缺少量化评测结果，属增量档
abstract: Hospitals regularly buy software that clinicians and patients depend on. Because these purchases are costly, hard to reverse and can affect patient care, buyers look for evidence of which peer institutions already use a product and which systems it connects to. This evidence is public but scattered across vendor websites, press releases and third-party pages. Language-model agents can now collect it at low cost, but the correctness of the extracted claims is difficult to establish, and a wrongly listed customer can mislead buyers and misrepresent an organisation. We present a pipeline that builds a knowledge graph of customer and integration relations from the open web under one rule: every edge must be supported by a verbatim quote from its source page. Pages come from a deterministic crawl of each vendor's site and a budgeted ReAct agent that searches the rest of the web. A permissive extractor proposes relations with quotes, and a layered grounding stage decides which to keep, using a referent step that reads the whole page when a quote names only one side, deterministic checks, and a panel of five model calls voting on nine criteria. On 61 vendors, the pipeline reaches 0.94 precision and 0.71 recall against a page-level key covering the 6,428 candidate relations proposed by its extractor, whose verdicts were drafted by one model and re-checked with a second. Against the golden reference, the marketplace's own curated list, it scores lower, but 89% of the relations it keeps that the reference lacks are stated on a page. A confidence score built from the panel's votes keeps more correct relations than the fixed rule at the same precision, and reaches 0.90 precision at 0.90 recall. We also discuss how narrow, bounded model calls, string-matched evidence and voting address long-context degradation and run-to-run variance.
zh_abstract: 医院经常购买临床医生和患者所依赖的软件。由于这些采购成本高昂、难以逆转且可能影响患者护理，买家会寻找证据，了解哪些同行机构已经使用某产品以及该产品连接哪些系统。这些证据是公开的，但分散在供应商网站、新闻稿和第三方页面上。语言模型智能体现在能以低成本收集这些证据，但所提取声明的正确性难以确认，而错误列出的客户可能误导买家并错误呈现某个组织。我们提出一个流水线，从开放网络构建客户与集成关系的知识图谱，遵循一条规则：每条边都必须由其来源页面中的逐字引文支持。页面来自对每个供应商网站的确定性爬取，以及一个预算受限的 ReAct 智能体对其余网络的搜索。一个宽松的抽取器提出带引文的关系，分层接地阶段决定保留哪些关系，使用一个指代步骤（当引文只提到一侧时读取整个页面）、确定性检查，以及由五次模型调用组成的小组按九项标准投票。在 61 个供应商上，该流水线相对于覆盖其抽取器提出的 6,428 个候选关系的页面级键，达到 0.94 精确率和 0.71 召回率；该键的判定由一个模型起草并由第二个模型复核。相对于黄金参考，即市场自身整理的列表，它的得分较低，但它保留的而参考中缺失的关系中有 89% 在某个页面上有陈述。由小组投票构建的置信度分数在相同精确率下比固定规则保留更多正确关系，并在 0.90 召回率时达到 0.90 精确率。我们还讨论狭窄、有界的模型调用、字符串匹配证据和投票如何应对长上下文退化与运行间方差。

title: Semantic Representation for Agentic Self-Play in Automated Laboratories
zh_title: VERID：自动化实验室的语义数字孪生基础设施
summary: 提出实验室工作单元的语义数字孪生基础设施，以衔接AI智能体推理与湿实验物理执行。
key_points: 面向智能体自博弈的实验室语义数字孪生
提供可查询内省与压缩时间模拟

abstract: Navigating complex, high-dimensional biological search spaces necessitates scalable physical and computational intelligence to explore beyond local optima through iterative self-play across ideation, experimentation, and automation. Translating experimental designs into reliable physical execution remains bottlenecked by static laboratory automation and unmodeled physical variability. To address this, we introduce VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories, or VERID, a foundational infrastructure designed to bridge the gap between the high-level reasoning of artificial intelligence (AI) agents and complex, error-prone physical realities of wet labs. VERID is a persistent, high-fidelity semantic digital twin of the laboratory workcell that provides four core services: queryable introspection for agentic reasoning, time-compressed simulation for protocol validation, comprehensive trace persistence for a complete scientific record, and a framework for safe execution. We present three case studies using aqueous dye and deionized water mixtures to validate the optical and fluidic foundations of VERID. These studies demonstrate how VERID enables pre-emptive detection of critical errors in experimental protocols, stateful mid-run error recovery and post-hoc identification of subtle physical failures. The simulation functions as a discrete accounting engine, allowing agents to safely and inexpensively explore experimental designs in silico and refine experimental strategies through iterative self-play. VERID also captures structured multimodal experimental data for downstream analysis, knowledge mining and agent training. We argue that this semantic layer is an essential prerequisite for deploying autonomous agents in the biochemical and biomedical sciences, ensuring data integrity, operational safety, and paving the way for tackling previously intractable grand challenges in biology.
zh_abstract: 在复杂、高维的生物搜索空间中导航，需要可扩展的物理与计算智能，通过跨构思、实验和自动化的迭代自我博弈来探索超越局部最优的方案。将实验设计转化为可靠的物理执行，仍受限于静态的实验室自动化和未建模的物理变异性。为解决这一问题，我们引入用于发现实验室的验证基础设施（VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories，VERID），这是一种基础性基础设施，旨在弥合人工智能（AI）智能体的高层推理与湿实验室复杂、易出错的物理现实之间的差距。VERID 是实验室工作单元的持久、高保真语义数字孪生，提供四项核心服务：用于智能体推理的可查询内省、用于方案验证的时间压缩仿真、用于完整科学记录的全流程轨迹持久化，以及安全执行框架。我们展示了三项使用水性染料和去离子水混合物的案例研究，以验证 VERID 的光学和流体学基础。这些研究证明 VERID 如何能够预先检测实验方案中的关键错误、实现运行中途的状态化错误恢复，以及事后识别细微的物理故障。该仿真充当离散核算引擎，使智能体能够安全且低成本地在计算机中探索实验设计，并通过迭代自我博弈改进实验策略。VERID 还捕获结构化多模态实验数据，用于下游分析、知识挖掘和智能体训练。我们认为，这一语义层是在生物化学和生物医学科学中部署自主智能体的必要前提，可确保数据完整性和操作安全，并为应对生物学中以往难以解决的重大挑战铺平道路。

title: Investigating the trackability of landmarks in NBI and WLI
zh_title: NBI与WLI内镜标志点可追踪性比较
summary: 在61段喉内镜视频中比较窄带与白光成像下标志点跟踪误差，NBI在声带区域显著降低误差。
key_points: 纳入39例患者共61段内镜视频
比较CSRT与两种学习型点跟踪器
NBI在声带区显著降低前向-后向误差

abstract: Reliable visual tracking of anatomical landmarks in endoscopic video is a key prerequisite for computer-assisted interventions in laryngeal surgery. While Narrow Band Imaging (NBI) is clinically established for enhancing vascular contrast, its effect on automated tracking relative to conventional White Light Imaging (WLI) remains unexplored. We present a quantitative comparison of landmark trackability in NBI and WLI using a forward-backward error framework applied to 61 endoscopic videos from 39 patients. Two regions of interest are evaluated: the vocal folds (VF) and mucosa with a prominent vascular pattern (MPVP). We compare a classical feature-based tracker (CSRT) against learning-based point trackers (CoTracker3-Online and TrackOnR) across both modalities. NBI consistently reduced the forward-backward error in both regions, reaching statistical significance for the vocal folds, while failure rates stayed low. These findings indicate that NBI can improve tracking robustness in laryngeal endoscopy, with implications for motion analysis, navigation, and robotic assistance.
zh_abstract: 在内镜视频中对解剖标志进行可靠的视觉跟踪是喉部手术计算机辅助干预的关键前提。虽然窄带成像（NBI）在增强血管对比度方面已在临床上确立，但其相对于传统白光成像（WLI）对自动跟踪的影响仍未得到探索。我们使用前向-后向误差框架，对来自39例患者的61段内镜视频进行了NBI与WLI中标志可跟踪性的定量比较。评估了两个感兴趣区域：声带（VF）和具有显著血管模式的黏膜（MPVP）。我们在两种模态下比较了经典基于特征的跟踪器（CSRT）与基于学习的点跟踪器（CoTracker3-Online和TrackOnR）。NBI在两种区域中均持续降低前向-后向误差，在声带达到统计学显著性，同时失败率保持较低。这些发现表明，NBI可提高喉内镜中的跟踪稳健性，并对运动分析、导航和机器人辅助具有重要意义。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University College, London; conditions: Sensorineural Hearing Loss, Tinnitus; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 84; status: ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] Background and study aims Hearing problems are becoming more common. In the UK around 18 million adults have hearing loss or hear ringing or buzzing in their ears, which is called tinnitus. Many people wait a long time to be seen, partly because there are not enough audiologists - the specialists who test hearing and treat hearing problems. The standard hearing test is called pure-tone audiometry. An audiologist plays quiet sounds at different pitches through headphones and the person presses a button each time they hear one. The test is accurate, but it takes 20 to 30 minutes to complete, and needs a trained audiologist for all of that time. For people with tinnitus and comorbidity it can be especially tiring and slow. The research team has built a version of this test that uses artificial intelligence, called AI-PTA. Instead of following a fixed pattern, it chooses each sound based on the responses already given, which should mean fewer sound presentations are needed to find the same result. The audiologist stays with the person throughout and remains in charge of the test. This study asks three questions. 1. Does AI-PTA give the same hearing results as the standard test? 2. Is it quicker? 3. And do patients and staff find it acceptable? Who can participate? Adults aged 18 or over who have been diagnosed with sensorineural hearing loss, either with or without tinnitus, and who are due to attend the Royal National ENT \& Eastman Dental Hospital in London. Participants need enough English to read and complete questionnaires and to be able to give informed consent. People who have or report hyperacusis (an unusual sensitivity to everyday sounds), an active ear infection, or recent ear surgery cannot take part. What does the study involve? They fill in a short questionnaire about their hearing health. They then have two hearing tests at that visit: the standard test, which is part of their normal care, and the AI-PTA test. Half of the participants have the standard test first and half have AI-PTA first, so that the order does not affect the results. zh_abstract: 【新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：圣保罗大学总医院（University of Sao Paulo General Hospital）；疾病：脊髓损伤（SCI）；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：NA；入组人数：24；状态：ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION】本临床试验的目标是研究由机器学习（ML）引导的个性化多电极经皮脊髓刺激（tSCS）联合步态训练，与单电极持续性刺激联合相同训练相比，能否改善脊髓损伤或卒中患者的步行功能。tSCS 是一种非侵入性技术，通过放置在脊柱上方皮肤上的电极传递电脉冲，以调控脊髓神经环路、促进下肢肌肉的募集，并支持自主运动的恢复。传统 tSCS 通常使用单个刺激电极，这可能限制对不同肌群的选择性募集。本研究探讨一种个性化多电极方法，以选择性募集特定下肢肌群，并在步态周期的适当相位传递刺激，旨在改善步行功能。本研究旨在回答的主要问题包括：1. 电极位置和刺激强度如何影响选择性肌肉募集，并且反应在参与者之间和不同日期之间如何变化？2. 基于 ML 的优化能否使用更少的测试和更少的时间，识别出选择性可与肌肉反应完整映射相媲美的刺激设置？3. 当二者均联合步态训练时，与单电极持续性刺激相比，与特定步态相位同步的个性化多电极刺激能否更大程度地改善步行功能？该研究包括 24 名参与者（14 名脊髓损伤患者和 10 名卒中患者），分为两个阶段。阶段 1——tSCS 选择性表征与刺激优化 所有参与者在仰卧状态下完成两次实验场次。研究人员比较中央电极和多个脊柱电极位置刺激引起的肌肉反应。使用表面肌电图（EMG）记录腿部肌肉的电反应，并使用成对电脉冲评估脊髓反射。通过系统测试电极位置和刺激强度，研究人员构建了每种设置下哪些腿部肌肉发生反应的地图（刺激景观）。他们评估不同肌群的选择性募集，比较刺激位置，并检查参与者之间以及两次实验场次之间的差异。他们还测试基于 ML 的优化能否更高效地找到具有相似选择性的设置

abstract: [Pharmacy (Basel, Switzerland)] The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into educational environments is accelerating, with growing interest in its potential to enhance learning outcomes. This pilot study aimed to assess student perceptions regarding the quality and educational impact of AI-generated feedback. Second-professional-year pharmacy students (n = 148) enrolled in a drug literature evaluation course received AI-generated feedback for a draft assignment which required students to critically evaluate a recently published journal article. Feedback was generated by an AI assistant that offered iterative feedback based on the assignment rubric. After the activity, students completed an electronic survey instrument evaluating the AI feedback regarding its alignment with rubric criteria, accuracy, clarity, and tone. Student perceptions of the feedback's impact on learning were also assessed. A total of 148 students (100%) completed the activity and responded to at least one item of the survey tool. Most students agreed with the AI-generated feedback for each section of the assignment in regard to clarity (61.5% to 76.2%) and tone (66.9% to 74.3%), with lower agreement related to alignment with the rubric (33.8% to 60.4%) and accuracy (34.5% to 54.2%). Students also expressed concern about the reliability of AI feedback (71.2%) and risk for plagiarism (50%). AI-generated feedback was positively received in some areas. However, students expressed apprehension regarding its accuracy, reliability, and potential accusation of plagiarism. These findings suggest further refinement is necessary to enhance AI trustworthiness and educational value in academic settings.
zh_abstract: [Pharmacy (Basel, Switzerland)] 人工智能（AI）融入教育环境的进程正在加速，人们对其提升学习结果的潜力日益关注。本试点研究旨在评估学生对 AI 生成反馈的质量和教育影响的看法。修读药物文献评价课程的第二专业年药学学生（n = 148）针对一项要求学生对近期发表的期刊文章进行批判性评价的初稿作业，获得了 AI 生成的反馈。反馈由 AI 助手生成，该助手根据作业评分标准提供迭代反馈。活动结束后，学生完成了一份电子调查工具，从与评分标准条目的一致性、准确性、清晰度和语气方面评价 AI 反馈。还评估了学生对反馈对学习影响的看法。共有 148 名学生（100%）完成了活动，并回答了调查工具中的至少一个条目。多数学生在作业各部分的清晰度（61.5% 至 76.2%）和语气（66.9% 至 74.3%）方面同意 AI 生成的反馈，而在与评分标准的一致性（33.8% 至 60.4%）和准确性（34.5% 至 54.2%）方面同意度较低。学生还表达了对 AI 反馈可靠性（71.2%）和剽窃风险（50%）的担忧。AI 生成的反馈在某些方面受到积极评价。然而，学生对其准确性、可靠性以及可能被指控剽窃表示忧虑。这些发现表明，需要进一步改进，以提高 AI 在学术环境中的可信度和教育价值。

abstract: Feature analysis is a crucial step in medical image analysis, particularly in breast cancer classification. Traditional image analysis methods often struggle with optimal patterns along the diagonal axis, computational efficiency and feature buffer storage. Different classical operators require high-efficiency hardware for the complex operations, such as image convolution and gradient analysis, which are used for processing complex machine learning models for training and test operations. Here, in this research, we introduce a non-interpolation virtual trellis-based (NVHT) operator that utilizes a filter kernel over the same square image without transformation to a hexagonal trellis. This proposed method is very efficient in reducing computational and storage costs. The proposed operator is used for improved feature extraction efficiency and accuracy in disease classification. This method outperforms conventional approaches by leveraging a hexagonal pixel representation while maintaining high sensitivity in different directions with less storage.
zh_abstract: 特征分析是医学图像分析中的关键步骤，尤其是在乳腺癌分类中。传统图像分析方法往往难以处理对角轴上的最优模式、计算效率和特征缓冲区存储问题。不同的经典算子需要高效硬件来执行复杂操作，如图像卷积和梯度分析，这些操作被用于处理复杂机器学习模型的训练和测试操作。在本研究中，我们引入一种非插值虚拟网格基（NVHT）算子，该算子在同一方形图像上使用滤波核，而不转换为六边形网格。所提方法在降低计算和存储成本方面非常高效。所提算子用于提高疾病分类中特征提取的效率和准确性。该方法通过利用六边形像素表示，同时在各个方向上保持高灵敏度且存储更少，优于传统方法。

abstract: Type 2 diabetes is a widespread chronic disease that requires early and accurate diagnosis to prevent serious complications. Traditional diagnostic methods often lack sufficient accuracy, which highlights the need for more reliable computational solutions. In this study, we propose a model that integrates the Random Forest classifier with the Bat Optimization Algorithm for simultaneous feature selection and hyperparameter tuning. The SMOTE-ENN method was first applied to the Pima Indians Diabetes Database to correct class imbalance and remove noisy or ambiguous samples, producing a more balanced and cleaner dataset. The optimized model trained on this refined dataset achieved 89% accuracy, 88% precision, 90% recall, and an F1-score of 89%, clearly outperforming the baseline Random Forest and other existing approaches. These results demonstrate the potential of combining evolutionary algorithms with ensemble learning to provide a practical and cost-effective tool for early detection of type 2 diabetes in clinical practice.
zh_abstract: 2型糖尿病是一种广泛存在的慢性疾病，需要早期、准确的诊断以预防严重并发症。传统诊断方法往往缺乏足够准确性，这凸显了对更可靠计算解决方案的需求。在本研究中，我们提出一种将随机森林分类器与蝙蝠优化算法相结合的模型，用于同时进行特征选择和超参数调优。首先将SMOTE-ENN方法应用于皮马印第安人糖尿病数据库（Pima Indians Diabetes Database），以纠正类别不平衡并去除噪声或模糊样本，从而生成更平衡、更干净的数据集。在该精炼数据集上训练的优化模型达到89%准确率、88%精确率、90%召回率和89%的F1分数，明显优于基线随机森林和其他现有方法。这些结果证明了将进化算法与集成学习相结合，为临床实践中2型糖尿病早期检测提供实用且成本效益高的工具的潜力。
